job.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
job.description:
JOB TITLE:
Enterprise Customer Success Manager

Location:
Remote – U.S.

Compensation:
We feel passionately about transparency in compensation. Total compensation for this role is market competitive, offering a base salary range of $85,000–$100,000, with an quarterly target bonus.

About the Role

Snappy is looking for an Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Success Team.
In this role, you will be a key team member in the Customer Success organization driving retention, growth, and measurable outcomes for Snappy's Enterprise customer segment. You'll own the health and revenue performance of your book of business across the full customer journey, while working closely with internal teams to ensure customers are deeply engaged with and getting value from Snappy. You will partner closely with the Enterprise Account Management team in creating, building, and maintaining company-wide employee recognition programs among your customer base. We're looking for individuals with proven success in an environment of constant change and ambiguity — the ideal candidate is experienced in building and maintaining customer relationships, fearless when it comes to going above and beyond for customers, and is someone who embraces AI and modern tooling to work smarter and move faster.

You Will:

  • Manage a book of business of Enterprise customers who each spend approximately $15k–$100k/year, with direct accountability for NRR and retention outcomes

  • Exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual targets

  • Build and grow strategic, long-term relationships with multiple stakeholders at each customer in your book of business

  • Onboard and activate new customers coming into your book from expansions and graduations from our onboarding team

  • Conduct cadence calls with your customers to regularly ensure they're getting value from their Snappy platform and sharing best practices as an employee recognition expert

  • Identify and drive upsells for your customers to launch additional gifting campaigns

  • Lead executive business reviews with customers to review progress towards their goals and outcomes, and identify challenges to mitigate moving forward

  • Drive retention campaign outreach and execution to ensure campaigns come back year after year

  • Collaborate with internal operations partners to execute on customer program requests

  • Act as the main point of contact for any customer issue escalation, and work with our internal teams to resolve

  • Leverage AI tools and internal reporting to analyze your book, surface risks and opportunities, and prioritize the highest-impact customer actions

  • Convey product feedback to our product and engineering partners to contribute to our roadmap

 

You Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing role at a SaaS/tech company

  • Experience as a Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, or related role managing a book of business

You are:

  • Passionate about delivering measurable customer outcomes and driving revenue growth, not just satisfaction

  • Curious about and comfortable with AI — you actively use AI tools in your day-to-day and are excited to explore how they can make you a more effective CSM

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and manage your time efficiently

  • A strong team player who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Someone who takes initiative and is excited to embrace change

 

 

Snappy is the award-winning, all-in-one gifting company that spreads joy, shares gratitude, and takes the guesswork out of gifting.

Founded in 2015, Snappy was named one of Inc.’s fastest-growing companies in the Northeast in 2021, 2022, and 2023. Snappy is the trusted gifting and swag partner to over 43% of Fortune 100 companies as well as thousands of individuals who use Snappy for personal gifting. Snappy has sent more than five million gifts worldwide.

Snappy thrives on connecting people and cultivating meaningful relationships through the power of gratitude and gifting. Our recipient-picks experience ensures gift-givers send the perfect gift every time, for everyone, on every occasion.Snappy has been featured on Fortune’s "Best Small & Medium Workplaces," “Best Workplace for Millennials,” and “Best Workplace in Tech” lists.

We've seen firsthand that our unique product and brand experience boosts employee morale, improves performance, and (most importantly!) spreads joy, so, of course, we practice what we preach! Here at Snappy, we believe wholeheartedly in building a culture of appreciation, dedication, and fun. We offer benefits and perks to our employees including but not limited to: Free healthcare, including vision and dental, generous 401k match, flexible PTO, paid family leave, Snappy Summer Fridays (which we enjoy year-round!) and Snappy gifts for employee recognition and appreciation.

Snappy's stance on diversity, equity and inclusion, its active focus on give-back programs, and its fundamental mission to spread joy through the power of gifting all lead the way in unlocking the power of human kindness at work.

Snappy is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Snappy provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and employment process. If you need an accommodation to participate in the hiring process, please contact hanna.tsyrlin@snappy.com.

Information collected and processed as part of your Snappy hiring process, including as part of your Snappy career profile and in any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to Snappy Recruitment Privacy Notice

job.title: Head of Commercial, ShopBack Pay
job.description:
Our Journey

The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.


The Opportunity

We're not hiring a sales manager to run a team. We're looking for a builder — someone who has scaled a payments or F&B platform business before, knows what it takes to take something from pilot to market leader, and wants full ownership of the next chapter. You'll carry direct P&L accountability, run your own sales, marketing, and ops org, and hold the mandate to strike merchant partnerships that shift the market.

If you've built or scaled a fintech, payments, or F&B platform in Singapore — and you're hungry to do it again with members already primed to spend — this is your seat.

What You'll Own

  • Full P&L ownership for ShopBack Pay in Singapore — the growth, the strategy, and the bottom line are yours to drive.
  • The sales, marketing, and operations org — hiring, structure, performance, and execution.
  • Merchant and partner relationships — build the deals that make ShopBack Pay the default way people pay.
  • Omnichannel growth, working closely with regional stakeholders and local online business heads.
  • The team — lead, mentor, and grow the people who'll help you scale this like a founder would.
  • ShopBack Pay's edge — stay ahead of industry trends, competitor moves, and market opportunity.
  • A seat in shaping ShopBack's broader culture and success story.

Essentials to Succeed

  • Proven experience scaling a payments, fintech, or dine-out / F&B business in Singapore — you've built something and grown it, not just managed it.
  • A track record of direct P&L ownership, with the numbers to back it up.
  • Deep online-to-offline sales leadership experience; a food/retail tech background is a strong plus.
  • History of building and leading lean, high-performing sales teams with a fast, iterative mindset.
  • A strong network of merchant partners in food and retail, and the instinct to turn relationships into growth.
  • AI Builder mindset — you use tools like Claude or Cursor to move faster and build smarter, not just talk about AI.
  • Founder-grade ownership — grit, resilience, and the hunger to win even when it's hard.

ShopBacker Traits

  • Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.
  • Judgement - We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.
  • Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
  • Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

What's in it for ShopBackers

  • Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.
  • Be part of a winning team on a journey to global scale.
  • Competitive compensation based on performance.
  • Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.

job.title: Strategic Key Account Manager (Singapore & Malaysia)
job.description:
Our Journey

The ShopBack Group is Asia-Pacific's leading shopping and rewards platform, trusted by over 20 million active members across 13 markets, including Germany and the United States. Driven by the vision to make every day more rewarding, ShopBack saves members money and time with more ways to earn and more to do with what they earn, and empowers merchants and brand partners to effectively engage its members. Founded in Singapore in 2014, ShopBack now powers over US$5.5 billion in annual sales and half a million transactions a day for more than 20,000 online and in-store partners.


About the Role

You'll own a portfolio of high-value merchant accounts, growing what's there and hunting for new partnerships. This role blends account management with commercial acumen - your edge is understanding merchant budgets, seeing where deals can be unlocked, and crafting custom solutions that go beyond standard packages.

Built for someone with hustle, commercial instinct, and the drive to close.

What You'll Own

  • Portfolio growth. Own revenue, GMV, and Ads targets across your accounts, and the plan for how you hit them — through campaign and account planning, and consistent on-time delivery.
  • Commercial negotiation. Negotiate commission rates, pitch Ads packages, and secure co-marketing budgets. Build the business case, defend the margin, close the deal.
  • New partnerships. Map the whitespace in your categories, prioritise the merchants worth pursuing, and land them — from first outreach to closed deal.
  • Tailored solutions. Understand each merchant's budget cycle, internal targets, and constraints, then design proposals that go beyond the standard package and still hold up commercially on our side.
  • Campaigns end to end. Pitch, launch, monitor, and report — acting on the numbers mid-flight rather than after. Then use the results to earn the next, larger commitment.
  • Account health. Stay on top of tracking issues, reconciliation queries, and day-to-day operational fixes to support commercial conversations. 
  • Cross-functional delivery. Work with Operations, Marketing, and Business Intelligence to scale what's working from one account into a category-wide play.

What We're Looking For

    Must-have:

  • 3–4 years in ecommerce, affiliate, or fast-paced B2B/sales environments
  • Proven ability to understand client budgets and craft custom solutions (not just sell standard packages)
  • Commercial instinct with hustle - self-starter who thrives under pressure and delivers results
  • Strong communication and analytical skills
  • Proficiency in English and AI tools to improve workflows

ShopBacker Traits

  • Agency - We take ownership and act, rather than waiting for permission. When something's blocking progress, we find a way through it and follow through until it's done.
  • Judgement - We aim for high-impact decisions, not just easy wins, and we put the bigger picture ahead of individual interests. That means moving quickly and confidently, while staying thoughtful about when a call really matters.
  • Learning Velocity - We pick up new skills fast and let go of old habits just as quickly when something better comes along. We benchmark ourselves against the best and keep raising our own bar.
  • Tenacity - We stay in it when things get hard, keeping a level head under pressure. We debate openly before deciding, then commit fully — and support each other along the way.

What's in it for ShopBackers

  • Career growth opportunities to take on greater challenges that help you realise your ambitions.
  • Be part of a winning team on a journey to global scale.
  • Competitive compensation based on performance.
  • Candid, open, and collaborative culture where feedback is valued.

job.title: (Junior) Sales Manager (m/w/d)
job.description:
Als (Junior) Sales Manager (m/w/d) im Small & Medium Business (SMB) begleitest du Geschäftskund:innen durch den gesamten Vertriebsprozess, vom ersten Kontakt über den erfolgreichen Abschluss bis zum Ausbau der Kundenbeziehung. Mit deinem Gespür für smarte digitale Lösungen und deiner Leidenschaft für den Vertrieb überzeugst du Kund:innen von unseren SaaS-Produkten.

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid (Office & Homeoffice)

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du gewinnst neue Geschäftskund:innen im SMB-Segment und eröffnest neue Opportunities. Gemeinsam mit dem Sales-Team baust du unseren Vertrieb aus und bringst unsere innovativen Produkte erfolgreich an den Markt.
  • Du baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen in enger Abstimmung mit Customer Success gezielt aus, erkennst weiteren Bedarf und begeisterst deine Kund:innen durch Cross-Selling für zusätzliche Benefits aus unserem Portfolio.
  • Du erkennst die Bedürfnisse deiner Kund:innen, entwickelst daraus langfristige Partnerschaften und arbeitest kontinuierlich daran, deine Conversion Rate zu steigern.
  • Du findest den richtigen Kanal, um deine Kund:innen für unsere digitalen Lösungen zu begeistern, ob Webinar, Präsentation, Event oder Telefonat.
  • Du managst deine Pipeline eigenverantwortlich, steuerst deine Opportunities aktiv und trägst die Umsatzverantwortung für dein Kundensegment über das gesamte Produktportfolio der Spendit AG.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleg:innen aus Sales, Marketing, Customer Relations und Customer Success zusammen und sorgst so für eine nahtlose Customer Journey und ein effektives Onboarding.
  • Du bringst Insights und Feedback direkt aus dem Markt ins Unternehmen ein und gestaltest so die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte aktiv mit.
  • Du analysierst deine KPIs wie Terminzahlen, Conversion Rates, Forecasts und Aktivitäten und hältst deinen Teamlead regelmäßig auf dem Laufenden.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Vertrieb oder Wirtschaft oder einen vergleichbaren Werdegang.
  • Du bringst erste Erfahrung im B2B-Direktvertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und Value Selling ist für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Dein Herz schlägt für den Vertrieb digitaler Lösungen. Ambitionierte Ziele sind dir genauso wichtig wie eine gute Arbeitsatmosphäre und ein dynamisches Team.
  • Du überzeugst mit ausgeprägter Kundenorientierung und exzellenter Kommunikation, schriftlich wie mündlich.
  • Du führst Gespräche mit Entscheidungsträger:innen sicher und souverän auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du gehst gerne aktiv auf Menschen zu und nutzt dafür die passenden Kanäle, vom Telefon bis zu Social Media.
  • Du zeigst hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, arbeitest selbstständig und denkst im Team. Du leistest einen echten Beitrag zum Teamerfolg und möchtest dich dabei kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office. Erfahrung mit Salesforce oder einem vergleichbaren CRM ist von Vorteil.

Warum wir?

Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld in einer der aufregendsten Gegenden Münchens, dem Glockenbachviertel.

  • Täglicher Essenszuschuss: Genieße an jedem Arbeitstag dein von Spendit bezuschusstes Mittagessen.
  • Gehaltsextras über die SpenditCard: Freue dich über ein monatliches Guthaben auf deiner Visa Card, das du individuell nutzen kannst.
  • Vergünstigtes Deutschlandticket: Profitiere von einem monatlichen Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket für die betriebliche und private Nutzung.
  • Zugang zu Firmenfitness-Programm: Trainiere mit unserem Partner Wellhub in tausenden Fitnessstudios deutschlandweit oder in Online-Kursen via Livestream und nutze eine Vielzahl an Wellbeing-Apps. Spendit übernimmt die Lizenzgebühr.
  • Hardware-Leasing: Lease hochwertige Technik über unseren Partner meinMPP und profitiere durch Bruttogehaltsumwandlung von attraktiven Konditionen gegenüber dem regulären Kaufpreis.

Wir legen großen Wert auf Work-Life-Balance. Daher bieten wir flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten sowie 20 Arbeitstage pro Jahr “work abroad” in der EU.

Bei uns hast du zahlreiche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir unterstützen deine berufliche Weiterbildung sowohl intern als auch extern, und jede:r Mitarbeitende erhält hierfür ein Weiterbildungsbudget.

Gemeinsame Mittagspausen, Team-Events und Office Gatherings sind Teil unserer Unternehmenskultur. Bei uns sind kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien selbstverständlich. Und übrigens, bei uns sind auch Hunde herzlich willkommen!

Über uns

Spendit ist ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter Anbieter digitaler Mitarbeiter-Benefits mit Sitz in München. Das 2014 gegründete Scale-up unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihren Mitarbeitenden flexible Benefits mit Mehrwert einfach und digital anzubieten. Bereits über 10.000 Unternehmen in Deutschland und Österreich setzen auf die HR-Tech-Lösungen von Spendit.

job.title: 商品開発・体験施設開拓
job.description:
記憶に残る時間や思い出を贈れる、体験型のギフト。

ソウ・エクスペリエンスは、2005年に「体験を贈る」文化を日本で初めてサービス化した当時から、全国各地のパートナーと直接契約を結び、市場を切り拓いてきました。

本求人では、パートナー開拓をベースに、体験プロダクトの推進を担う方を募集します。営業活動に留まらず、コンテンツ拡充やUX向上に伴うシステム改善など、商品設計・サービス改善まで業務領域を拡張できるポジションです。

このポジションの魅力

  • ノルマなしのパートナー営業：売り切りではなく、お付き合いが長く続くストック型のビジネス。事業者の強みを深く引き出し、長期的なアライアンス向上に向き合えます。
  • 体験の魅力を最大化し、市場へ届ける：手掛けた体験コースが誰かの特別な日のギフトになり、ユーザー・事業者双方に価値をもたらす。自身の介在によって事業や人の心を動かす手応えを味わえます。
  • マルチなスキル形成：対人交渉力、データに基づく改善企画、Webページのディレクション、運用プロセスの構築など、キャリアの幅が広がります。

募集要項

配属：ビジネス本部 加盟店ユニット

業務内容

  • 体験ギフトで提携する施設の新規開拓（調査、営業、施設紹介ページの作成）
  • その他、商品改善や機能改善のプロジェクト進行など

スキル・資質（必須）

  • 営業経験（商材不問）
  • 社内外の多数の人と円滑に仕事を推進できるコミュニケーション力
  • 論理的思考力
  • 社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込み、プロジェクトを推進した経験

スキル・資質（優遇・歓迎）

  • プロダクトの営業経験
  • 業務、事業の改善経験
  • ライティング経験
  • 組織づくりやチームマネジメントの経験、または興味関心

求める人物像

  • 幅広い業務に対して、知的好奇心をもって前向きに取り組むことができる方
  • 社内外問わず仕事で関わる相手へのリスペクトがある方
  • リーダーシップを持って、自ら業務を進められる方

応募資格：学歴不問

待遇

  • 給与は当社給与体系と前職の給与をふまえて決定
  • 交通費支給
  • 社会保険、厚生年金、雇用/労働保険完備
  • 自社商品の社内割引あり
  • オフィス内フリードリンクあり
  • 年次有給休暇に加え長期休暇10日間付与（入社当日より付与）

入社時期：応相談

雇用・勤務形態

  • 雇用形態：正社員
  • 試用期間：3ヶ月
  • 勤務時間：平日12:00〜15:00をコアタイムとしたフレックス制
  • 勤務地：東京都渋谷区千駄ヶ谷3-60-5 オー・アール・ディ原宿ビル B1F（現在は、勤務時間の50%までリモート勤務可）

福利厚生・諸手当：社内割引販売、オフィスフリードリンク、PC貸与（※BYOD制度を選択可）、インフルエンザ予防接種補助、健康診断

選考の流れ：書類選考、マネージャー・チームメンバーとの面談、他チームマネージャーとの面談、役員との最終面談、内定通知

※内定者数が募集人数に達し次第、エントリーを締め切ります。※エントリー後1週間以内を目安に、書類選考の結果をご連絡します。※選考の流れについては変更になる場合がございます。※エントリーから内定までの期間は平均約1ヶ月です。

job.title: 法人事業開発・ビジネスディベロップメント営業
job.description:
企業の課題に応じた体験設計から事業化までを担います。枠に囚われず、営業・企画・開発・アライアンスを横断し、価値をゼロから共創する仲間を募集します。

このポジションの魅力

  • 顧客ごとの自由なソリューション設計：決まった商品を売るのではなく、顧客課題から逆算して自ら提案を組み立て、価値をつくる面白さがあります。
  • 営業、事業開発、マーケを横断する動き：新規開拓やマーケ企画、新サービス・アライアンス開発まで幅広く関われます。
  • 市場そのものを創る経験：体験を活用した法人向けソリューションは、まだ確立された市場ではありません。

配属

ビジネス本部　ギフト流通ユニット　法人営業チーム

業務内容

提案営業・事業開発

  • 法人顧客への新規提案営業、および既存顧客へのアップセル・深耕提案
  • 顧客課題のヒアリング・仮説構築・提案設計
  • 福利厚生・表彰・インナーコミュニケーション・キャンペーンなど、企業課題に応じたソリューション提案
  • 提案内容に応じた体験プログラム・新サービス・商品の企画
  • 体験事業者との協業設計・アライアンス推進

プロジェクト推進・仕組み化

  • マーケティング・商品開発・オペレーションチームと連携したプロジェクト推進
  • 提案資料や営業プロセス、勝ちパターンの型化・仕組み化
  • 社内外のステークホルダーを巻き込んだプロジェクトマネジメント

事業成長・市場開拓

  • 法人事業の営業戦略・事業戦略の改善提案
  • 提供価値の検証・改善、再現性のある営業モデルの構築
  • 新たなユースケースの創出や市場開拓

スキル・資質

必須

  • 法人営業、事業開発、コンサルティング等を通じて、顧客課題の解決に携わった経験（5年以上）

優遇・歓迎

  • 新規事業や立ち上げフェーズの事業に携わった経験
  • 商品企画や営業企画、業務改善など営業以外の領域まで踏み込んだ経験
  • CRM、マーケティング支援などに関わる提案経験

求める人物像

  • 顧客との対話の中から、本質的な課題を見つけるのが好きな方
  • 正解がまだない環境でも、自分で仮説を置いて動ける方
  • 営業として成果を出すことと、仕組みをつくることの両方に興味がある方
  • 関係者を巻き込みながら前に進めることができる方

job.title: Merchandising & Cataloging Business Growth Manager
job.description:
Job Purpose: The Merchandising & Cataloging Business Growth Manager owns the growth of the product catalog as a revenue engine. The role is accountable for expanding the assortment through vendor and brand acquisition, keeping the catalog accurate and discoverable, and using digital merchandising levers such as widgets, carousels, banners, and recommendations to lift visibility, engagement, conversion, and average order value. This is not an operational catalog-maintenance role. Success is measured by business impact: new vendors and products live, week-on-week growth, conversion improvement, and the confidence of clients and senior management in the growth plan.

The incumbent is the key bridge between vendors, internal operations and technology teams, and clients (including banking, BFSI, and fintech partners running rewards and loyalty programs). They will:

  • Identify where the catalog is losing business, whether through assortment gaps, poor visibility, weak pricing, or inaccurate content, and fix it.
  • Bring in the right vendors and products at competitive commercial terms and get them live quickly.
  • Plan and execute a weekly cadence of merchandising interventions and measure their impact.
  • Present performance, insights, and growth strategy to clients and leadership in structured weekly and monthly reviews.

Vendor Acquisition & Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and source new vendors and brands across priority categories to close assortment gaps and expand the catalog in line with customer demand and client programme objectives.
  • Approach vendors, assess the quality, pricing, fulfilment capability, and reliability of their offerings, and negotiate competitive pricing, margins, and commercial terms.
  • Present shortlisted vendors and products to clients with a clear business case and secure timely approvals.
  • Own end-to-end vendor onboarding: documentation, KYC, commercial agreements, SLAs, and product activation, in coordination with Legal, Finance, and Operations.
  • Ensure vendor onboarding follows company information security and data-protection policies, including appropriate handling of vendor and customer personal data under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023.
  • Build long-term vendor relationships; conduct periodic performance reviews on pricing, fill rate, fulfilment TAT, and quality, and act on underperformance.

Merchandising & Catalog Management

  • Drive end-to-end product onboarding and catalog activation, from data intake to live listing.
  • Ensure product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, categorisation, attributes, and specifications are accurate, consistent, and optimised for search and discovery.
  • Monitor catalog health continuously: product availability, out-of-stocks, pricing accuracy, broken listings, and content quality.
  • Identify assortment gaps through demand, search, and competitive analysis, and build an assortment plan to close them.
  • Ensure every newly onboarded product is activated, correctly mapped, and visible to customers within the defined TAT.
  • Define and enforce catalog standards and quality checklists with internal teams and vendors.

Business Growth & Digital Merchandising

  • Develop and execute digital merchandising strategies that improve business performance across website and app.
  • Optimise placements using widgets, carousels, banners, promotional sections, curated collections, and product recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product visibility, customer engagement, click-through rate, conversion rate, and average order value.
  • Plan and run a weekly merchandising and promotional calendar, aligned to seasons, festivals, client campaigns, and inventory priorities.
  • Run structured tests (e.g., A/B tests on placements, creatives, and sort order), analyse the impact of each intervention, and scale what works.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Technology teams to implement merchandising changes on schedule.

Client Management & Business Reviews

  • Act as the primary point of contact for presenting merchandising and growth initiatives to clients.
  • Prepare and deliver weekly business reviews covering activities completed, results achieved, challenges, and upcoming opportunities.
  • Present growth strategies, performance improvements, and recommendations with clear data support.
  • Obtain client approvals for new vendors, products, promotional campaigns, and merchandising changes, and drive approval turnaround.
  • Build trusted client relationships through structured communication, consistent delivery, and proactive escalation management.

Business Intelligence & Performance Reporting

  • Build and maintain business performance dashboards covering sales, revenue, conversion, product visibility, assortment growth, and merchandising performance.
  • Prepare accurate, on-time weekly and monthly performance reports.
  • Present business performance, growth opportunities, and improvement plans to senior management.
  • Convert data into specific, prioritised action plans, not just observations.
  • Ensure dashboards and reports use access-controlled, aggregated data and do not expose customer personal information unnecessarily.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Functional: vendor sourcing, evaluation, and commercial negotiation; e-commerce merchandising, assortment planning, and catalog management; business development and growth strategy; data analysis and business performance tracking; ability to convert business data into actionable growth initiatives.
  • Client & Stakeholder: client relationship management and stakeholder alignment across internal and external teams; strong presentation and storytelling skills, confident presenting to client CXOs and senior leadership; clear written and verbal communication.
  • Behavioural: end-to-end ownership and accountability for outcomes; bias for execution with a strong weekly operating rhythm; analytical, structured problem-solving; ability to manage multiple vendors, clients, and priorities under tight timelines.

Relevant Experience

  • 5 to 8 years of total experience, with at least 3 years in a hands-on merchandising, category, or catalog growth role.
  • Relevant backgrounds include e-commerce, quick commerce, online retail, marketplace operations, category management, merchandising, catalog management, or rewards and loyalty platforms.
  • Demonstrated track record of onboarding vendors, expanding assortment, and delivering measurable revenue or conversion improvement.
  • Experience presenting regular business reviews to clients or senior stakeholders.
  • Exposure to BFSI, banking, or loyalty-programme clients is a strong advantage.

Tools & Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel: pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Power Query, conditional logic, data modelling.
  • Advanced PowerPoint: executive-ready business review decks.
  • Dashboarding: Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, or similar.
  • E-commerce platforms: CMS / catalog or PIM tools, merchandising and banner management modules.
  • Web analytics: Google Analytics or equivalent for traffic, CTR, funnel, and conversion analysis.
  • Good to have: basic SQL, A/B testing tools, and familiarity with product feed and bulk-upload formats.

job.title: Program Account Manager
job.description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a professional, service-oriented, and passionate Program Engagement Manager (PEM) to help transform how team members around the world experience and engage with their workplace. This role is responsible for the implementation and ongoing support of recognition programs for both clients and their employees.

As a PEM, you support 40-60 customer accounts to keep their programs engaged, effective and fueling a culture of recognition. This is an on-site role at our Grand Rapids, MI, location and does not include any direct reports.

Essential duties and responsibilities

  • Account management: Perform daily account management and customer support for RecogNation clients.
  • Setting up and managing client technology platforms: Ensure seamless integration and efficient operation of the platforms used by our clients.
  • Client relations: Maintain strong relationships with assigned clients/accounts while developing a thorough understanding of their company needs and goals related to employee recognition and engagement.
  • Post-launch support: Resolve all inquiries and client concerns through to completion in a timely manner.
  • Develop and conduct client reviews: Regularly assess program performance, identifying areas of opportunity, understanding client needs and sharing product ideas to meet those needs, and sharing program performance on a regular cadence.

  • Approve work orders: Review and approve work orders prior to being sent to production for fulfillment.
  • Handle inbound telephone and email inquiries: Engaging directly with clients and employees to maintain excellent communication and support.
  • Data analysis: Analyzing program effectiveness and employee engagement metrics to make program enhancements.

Ideal candidate traits

  • Highly motivated and professional with excellent written and oral communication skills
  • Highly confident and goal-oriented individual with excellent attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills with employees, managers, and executives

  • Desire and aptitude to problem-solve and handle escalated issues appropriately

  • Strong computer skills and proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint

Key measures of success

  • Drive a 95% annual SaaS retention rate or greater

Requirements

  • Ability to represent RecogNation to clients with enthusiasm and professionalism
  • Strong ability to learn new technology/tech-savvy. Experience with MS Office with strong skills in Excel. Modern office practices, procedures, and equipment; English proficient in spelling, grammar and punctuation
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate positively and professionally. Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent customer service skills required. Proven ability to graciously deal with all types of customers

job.title: Sales Development Representative (gn) Outbound
job.description:
Als Teil der Bikeleasing Gruppe entwickeln wir bei Probonio Produkte und Services, die Mitarbeitervorteile neu denken, effizient, digital und mit echtem Impact. Wir bauen unsere Outbound-Vertriebsfunktion gezielt aus – und Du kannst von Anfang an dabei sein. Als Sales Development Representative (gn) mit Outbound-Fokus identifizierst Du strategische Zielkunden, betreibst aktiv Kaltakquise und generierst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives. Du arbeitest eng mit Account Management, Marketing und Deinem Teamlead zusammen und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass wir unser Kundensegment weiter ausbauen. Wenn Du Kommunikation liebst, strukturiert arbeitest und im Vertrieb wirklich etwas bewegen möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Klingt gut? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen und baust eigenständig eine strukturierte Target-Liste auf
  • Du betreibst aktiv Kaltakquise und kontaktierst Leads via Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn und weiteren Kanälen
  • Du entwickelst Messaging-Ansätze, die den Mehrwert unseres Multi-Benefit-Portfolios klar kommunizieren
  • Die Qualifizierung von Erstterminen für unsere Account Executives liegt in Deiner Verantwortung, dabei dokumentierst Du alle Aktivitäten sauber im CRM
  • Feedback aus dem Markt bringst Du aktiv ins Team zurück und trägst zur Optimierung unserer Outbound-Strategien bei

Deine Stärken

  • Du hast idealerweise erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, im Kundenservice oder in einer kommunikationsstarken Rolle
  • Du telefonierst gerne, gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu und kannst mit Hilfe unseres Playbooks den Produkt-Mehrwert vermitteln
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlierst Deine KPIs nicht aus dem Blick und bringst eine hohe Eigenmotivation mit
  • CRM-Systeme wie HubSpot oder Dynamics schrecken Dich nicht ab
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf Deutsch (C2) und hast Lust, Dich durch Feedback kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln

Warum zu uns?

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Gleitzeit - damit Du Berufliches und Privates gut miteinander vereinbaren kannst
  • Workation - einmal pro Jahr kannst Du bis zu drei Wochen im EU-Ausland arbeiten oder in einem Land, in dem Du über eine gültige Arbeitserlaubnis verfügst
  • Falls Du in der Nähe eines unserer Standorte in München, Landshut, Berlin, Vellmar oder Uslar wohnst, freuen wir uns über regelmäßigen persönlichen Austausch vor Ort
  • Du erhältst eine moderne technische Ausstattung für Deinen Arbeitsplatz im Büro und für das mobile Arbeiten
  • Zuschuss von 100 € zur Arbeitsplatzbrille bei Bedarf
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und ein transparenter Prozess für Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung
  • Ein Sommerfest und regelmäßige Teamevents sorgen für Austausch und gemeinsame Erlebnisse

Mehr fürs Leben

  • Monatlicher Sachbezugsgutschein im Wert von 50 € – zum Beispiel für Firmenfitness, Lebensmittel- und Baumärkte, Tankstellen oder Online-Shops
  • Geburtstagsgutschein im Wert von 60 €, einlösbar bei den gleichen Anbietern
  • 40 € Zuschuss zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit unserem Partner ERGO
  • Nach der Probezeit die Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei Fahrräder, E-Bikes oder Pedelecs über uns zu leasen
  • Bis zu 5 voll bezahlte Kind-krank-Tage pro Kind (max. 12 Tage pro Jahr)
  • Bis zu 2 Tage Sonderurlaub für verschiedene Lebensereignisse
  • Bei Bike2Future 10 % Rabatt auf Gebrauchträder und Leasingangebote sowie zwei Testwochen für die von Dir ausgewählten Bikes; bei einem Abo sind die ersten 4 Wochen kostenlos und es entfallen 99 € Startgebühren
  • Attraktive Vergünstigungen bei zahlreichen Partnern über Corporate Benefits und exklusive Mitarbeiterrabatte

Über uns

Probonio ist ein innovatives Softwareunternehmen. Unsere Software für Mitarbeiter-Benefits hilft Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit zu steigern und einen echten finanziellen Mehrwert zu bieten. Probonio ist Teil der Bikeleasing Gruppe, die mehr als 70.000 Unternehmenskunden umfasst, wodurch wir einer der führenden Anbieter von Mitarbeiter-Benefits sind.

Als junges Unternehmen denken wir "out of the box", testen neue Ansätze, lernen aus Rückschlägen und feiern gemeinsam Erfolge. Und das Beste? Bei uns hat jedes Teammitglied die Chance, etwas Großes zu bewegen und kreative Ideen zu verwirklichen.

Wir sehen Vielfalt als Bereicherung für unser Team. Darum freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen und möchten besonders Menschen mit Behinderung oder anderen Herausforderungen dazu ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

job.title: Partner Manager
job.description:
Prizeout is a leading NYC-based fintech company where innovation meets financial empowerment. We provide rewards and loyalty solutions to partners that transform how their customers engage and maximize financial potential.

We're seeking passionate individuals to drive our mission forward. Our team values humility, ownership, and problem-solving. We hire people who trust themselves, get things done, and thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.

About the Role

We're looking for a Partner Manager who genuinely loves people, thrives on building relationships, and takes pride in helping partners succeed.

You'll own a portfolio of financial institution partners, serving as their primary relationship manager and trusted advisor. You'll get to know the people behind each organization, understand their business goals and priorities, and help them maximize the value of their partnership with Prizeout.

The ideal candidate is naturally curious, personable, thoughtful, and exceptionally organized. You know how to build rapport, ask great questions, recognize opportunities and challenges, and proactively move relationships forward.

What You'll Do

  • Own and grow relationships with a portfolio of financial institution partners, building trusted connections across day-to-day and executive stakeholders.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each partner's business, goals, priorities, stakeholders, and active Prizeout programs.
  • Lead productive partner meetings and business reviews, sharing relevant insights, recommendations, and next steps.
  • Proactively identify partner needs, relationship risks, adoption opportunities, and opportunities to expand partnerships.
  • Help partners understand and maximize the value of Prizeout's products through relevant resources, recommendations, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to address partner needs, coordinate initiatives, and ensure commitments are delivered.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date partner information, meeting notes, opportunities, and follow-ups in our CRM.
  • Independently manage your portfolio, keeping leadership informed of meaningful developments and bringing forward thoughtful recommendations.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in account management, partnerships, client services, customer success, or another relationship-focused role.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a genuine enthusiasm for building meaningful, long-term relationships.
  • Strong emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and the ability to adapt to different personalities and situations.
  • Natural curiosity and the ability to ask thoughtful questions that uncover partner needs and opportunities.
  • Excellent organizational skills and a track record of independently managing multiple relationships and priorities.
  • Strong business judgment, proactive problem-solving skills, and the ability to take ownership without constant direction.
  • Confident communication and presentation skills, including experience leading client conversations.
  • Experience in fintech, financial services, SaaS, or a startup environment is a plus.

Please Note

  • Must be able to work full-time (5 days/week) in our NYC office.

  • Travel up to 10% may be required for partner meetings, onsite visits, and industry events.

  • Must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. indefinitely. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

    •  

    The expected salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000, plus an equity component.

What Is Prizeout?

Prizeout is an advertising and financial technology company that helps put money back into people’s pockets. Through Prizeout’s technology, brand-funded offers are available to partners across financial services, gaming, gig economy, and more -giving their users access to instant cashback when they shop using digital gift cards. Prizeout was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New York City.

job.title: Senior Marketing Manager
job.description:
Prezzee is a global leader in digital gifting and payments, having sold over 140 million gift cards through partnerships with more than 1,500 brands and serving over 6 million customers worldwide. Our mission is simple but powerful: to change lives through the power of giving — leveraging borderless payment technology and innovative digital solutions to help people connect and create meaningful moments.

About the role: 

We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Manager to own Prezzee’s global campaign calendar, bringing together Marketing, Product, Sales, and Partnerships to deliver standout B2C campaigns while driving consistency across B2B activity in our regions.

From global seasonal moments and product launches to promotions and strategic partnerships, you’ll lead end-to-end campaign planning and delivery that drives customer engagement, commercial growth, and memorable gifting experiences.

You’ll be at the centre of connecting teams, priorities, and markets to deliver impactful campaigns that support Prezzee’s growth ambitions.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage Prezzee’s integrated global campaign calendar across B2C and B2B activity.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of high-impact B2C campaigns across multiple channels.
  • Coordinate global campaign planning while partnering with regional teams on B2B activity.
  • Translate commercial objectives, product priorities, and business goals into coordinated campaign plans.
  • Deliver go-to-market plans for new products, features, and strategic initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product, Sales, Partnerships, and Marketing teams to deliver commercial outcomes.
  • Lead campaign measurement, optimization, and post-campaign insights to improve future performance.
  • Coach and support a Campaign Executive while driving best practices across campaign operations.
  • Continuously improve campaign processes, workflows, and ways of working to support scale and efficiency.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of experience delivering integrated marketing campaigns across multiple markets.
  • Experience leading cross-channel campaigns across CRM/email, paid media, social, SEO, PR, and web.
  • Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills, with the ability to influence teams across functions and regions.
  • Commercial mindset with experience using data and insights to optimise campaign performance.

job.title: Head of Product, PrezzeePay
job.description:
Prezzee is a global leader in digital gifting and payments, having sold over 140 million gift cards through partnerships with more than 1,500 brands and serving over 6 million customers worldwide. Our mission is to change lives through the power of giving — leveraging borderless payment technology and innovative digital solutions to help people connect and create memorable moments that truly matter.

 

Prezzee is looking for a seasoned product leader to own and elevate PrezzeePay as a core growth engine for the business. As Head of Product, PrezzeePay, you’ll own the vision, strategy, roadmap and end-to-end performance of the payments and issuing value stream. By working across the business and external partners, you’ll turn customer problems, business priorities and market opportunities into clear product strategies and measurable outcomes.

 

This is a senior strategic and operational leadership role where you’ll make the calls that shape what we build, why we build it and how we deliver it.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Define the long-term customer-led and data-driven strategy for PrezzeePay and own value-stream OKRs.
  • Build and manage a multi-quarter roadmap balancing customer value, commercial impact, technical sustainability and operational efficiency.
  • Lead customer and partner discovery, using behavioural data, analytics, research and experimentation to drive product decisions.
  • Identify new payment use cases, growth opportunities, business models and partnerships.
  • Own GTM strategy and partner closely with Marketing, Commercial, Partnerships, Operations, Risk and Compliance to launch and scale new capabilities.
  • Build strong relationships across schemes, processors, issuers and strategic partners.
  • Own prioritisation, business cases, ROI analysis and investment decisions across the value stream.
  • Lead multiple squads and drive alignment across Product, Engineering, UX, Data and other functions.
  • Own delivery, proactively managing dependencies, risks and blockers to ensure predictable outcomes.
  • Establish PrezzeePay as a growth product -not simply payments infrastructure.

 

What You Bring

  • 10+ years’ experience in product strategy, product management, portfolio leadership or program delivery within technology-driven organisations.
  • Strong experience leading multiple squads or large multidisciplinary teams.
  • Deep understanding of payments, issuing, prepaid open-loop and closed-loop cards, schemes, processors and program management.
  • Proven experience developing customer- and data-led product strategies and multi-quarter roadmaps.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including business cases, forecasting, modelling and ROI analysis.
  • Experience leading complex GTM initiatives and working with external partners.
  • Strong decision-making skills and the ability to make clear trade-offs in ambiguous environments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and executive-level communication.
  • Experience working with distributed and global teams.

 

Your Strengths

  • Strategic thinker with strong customer and commercial instincts.
  • Decisive, accountable and comfortable making tough prioritisation calls.
  • Outcome-driven, with a bias towards measurable impact over activity.
  • Analytical and data-literate, using evidence to drive decisions.
  • Influential leader who can align and galvanise cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring clarity to complex challenges.
  • Collaborative communicator who builds trust across teams and stakeholders.

 

Why Join Prezzee?

This is an opportunity to shape a strategically important product and help make payments a core growth engine for Prezzee.You’ll have the autonomy and influence to define the future of PrezzeePay, working with talented global teams to build scalable payments and issuing capabilities, accelerate partner and program launches, and unlock new customer and commercial opportunities.

job.title: Analista de Comunicação Pleno
job.description:
Se você se identifica com uma empresa jovem, dinâmica e ágil, onde a inquietude e a sede por inovação são princípios, e que tem como objetivo a entrega com foco na qualidade e na superação das expectativas do cliente, seu lugar é na Vertem! Aqui, valorizamos a colaboração e a criatividade, sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para os desafios do mercado. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais apaixonados e comprometidos, que trabalham em um ambiente estimulante e inspirador. Na Vertem, acreditamos no poder da tecnologia para transformar negócios e estamos em constante evolução para oferecer as melhores soluções aos nossos clientes. Venha fazer parte dessa equipe incrível e faça a diferença conosco!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Criação e Gestão de Réguas de CRM

  • Mapear oportunidades e etapas da jornada do cliente para desenhar réguas de relacionamento personalizadas;
  • Planejar e estruturar fluxos de comunicação orientados a objetivos (onboarding, ativação, reengajamento, retenção etc.);
  • Desenvolver cronogramas e lógicas de disparo (segmentação, timing, canal e conteúdo);

Gestão do Processo Criativo e Execução

  • Construir briefing completo das peças (e-mail, push, WhatsApp, SMS, etc) para agências ou áreas internas de criação;
  • Validar as peças recebidas, garantindo aderência ao objetivo da campanha, ao tom de voz da marca e às boas práticas de CRM;
  • Operacionalizar ou acompanhar o disparo nas ferramentas de automação, garantindo que a jornada seja corretamente executada;

Análise e Otimização de Performance

  • Monitorar e analisar os principais indicadores de performance (open rate, CTR, conversão, churn, entre outros);
  • Preparar relatórios e apresentações com insights e recomendações práticas;
  • Propor e implementar melhorias contínuas com base em dados, ajustando estratégia, segmentação e conteúdo;

Atendimento Consultivo

  • Atuar como ponte entre o cliente e as áreas internas, compreendendo o negócio, os desafios e as metas específicas de cada conta;
  • Facilitar a comunicação entre as pontas, garantindo o alinhamento entre briefing, execução e resultados;
  • Acompanhar entregas, fazer follow-up e garantir o cumprimento de prazos com qualidade;

Skills Comportamentais Desejadas

  • Organização e atenção a detalhes (imprescindível para controle de múltiplas jornadas);
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de análise crítica de resultados;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de sintetizar e apresentar informações;
  • Senso de prioridade e habilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos clientes simultaneamente;
  • Perfil colaborativo, com habilidade para interagir com áreas diversas (marketing, produto, dados, criação);

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Vivência no desenho e execução de réguas de CRM;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação e CRM, preferencialmente na Insider;
  • Familiaridade com jornada de cliente e segmentação de base;
  • Capacidade de elaborar e interpretar KPIs de marketing digital e CRM;
  • Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets e PowerPoint para análise e apresentação;
  • Vivência com briefing e validação de peças criativas (e-mail, push, WhatsApp, etc;

A vivência em projetos de AGRO pode ser um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

O que temos para te oferecer?

  • Flex Office – 2 dias de home office e 3 dias presenciais.
  • Day Off no aniversário – Seu dia especial, do jeito que preferir + Pontos no nosso Marketplace!

  • Sala de descompressão – Para recarregar as energias.
  • Total Pass – Acesso a academias e atividades físicas.
  • Frutas no escritório – Para um lanche saudável durante o expediente.

job.title: Ejecutivo Comercial
job.description:
Permanent Term Contract (duración determinada)

Job Description:

·       Fidelizar la cartera de clientes asignada:

-          Conocer a sus clientes, comprender su negocio y explorar oportunidades.

-          Construir relaciones a largo plazo con los principales interlocutores que interactúan en la gestión de nuestros servicios.

-          Gestionar sus expectativas vs nuestras soluciones, con el fin de alinearlas.

-          Asesorarlos y servirlos continuamente, trasladar conocimientos y experiencias.

-          Gestionar sus actividades de ventas a través del CRM.

 

·       Aumento de la cantidad de beneficiarios y  BV por beneficiario: UP SELL

-          Medir el potencial de crecimiento de cartera comparando N° beneficiarios vs N° trabajadores. (Calcular el % de entrega de beneficios vs el tope por planilla).

-          Atención ante nuevas contrataciones, proyectos, adquisiciones o expansiones, incorporación de otros beneficios. (ejemplo: empresas mineras que prestan servicio de alimentación a las contratas).

-          Calcular el ahorro para la empresa cliente y demostrar siempre el valor agregado de Sodexo.

 

·       Aumento del BV medio:

-          Comparar BV con otros clientes del mismo sector y tamaño de empresa, compartirlos con el cliente para convencerlos a incrementar el BV.

 

·       Clientes de la cartera que no compran productos de uso variable o extraordinario: CROSS SELL

-          Analizar oportunidades por estacionalidad de acuerdo con nuestras campañas y portafolio (Escolaridad, Gratificaciones, Aguinaldos, Aniversarios, Fechas Representativas, etc.)

-          Conocer la estructura orgánica de la empresa e identificar de acuerdo con su actividad principal el potencial de trabajadores en las distintas áreas de la organización.

-          Agendar visitas con motivos concretos y de interés para el cliente: “conocer expectativas”; presentar nuevos productos, actualizar información, negociar condiciones, definir procesos, etc.

 

·       Renegociación condiciones económicas o comerciales:

-          Manejo de tasa de retribución considerando BV (Business Valúe) actual y potencial, costo de distribución, forma de pago, zona geográfica, plazos de crédito, plazo de vigencia de contratos, etc.

Asegurar la cobranza efectiva dentro del plazo acordado.

job.title: Key Account Manager
job.description:

Permanent Regular

Job Description:

The Field Sales Hunter – Mid Accounts is responsible for acquiring new clients by targeting mid-sized companies and positioning Pluxee’s digital, SaaS-based solutions as essential tools for improving employee engagement, retention, and satisfaction. This role plays a strategic part in growing the customer base by conducting consultative sales, engaging decision-makers, and converting leads into long-term clients.

YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE

2. Consultative Sales Execution

Handle objections, navigate decision-making structures, and adapt pitch accordingly.

3. Negotiation & Deal Closure

4. Internal Collaboration

YOU ARE A MATCH IF...

job.title: Content Marketeer
job.description:
We are looking for our first Content Marketeer to build Payflip’s content machine for the AI era. You’ll design the system rather than write every word, produce content at a volume and speed a traditional team can’t match, and make sure every piece earns its place in the funnel. You create the fuel; our performance marketeer puts it in front of the right companies.

🌟 Where you fit in

Payflip started as a flexible rewards tool. Today, we’re becoming Belgium’s salary super app: one platform where companies and people manage their salaries and benefits. With Payroll joining Flex, Food and Mobility, the product is complete. Our market has never been this clear: Belgian employers in specific FTE ranges whom we can name company by company.

This year, we laid the marketing foundations: a new website, new ads, our first TV commercials and a billboard campaign. What we haven’t built yet is a steady flow of content that brings those companies to us. In 2027, that’s about to change.

You’ll join a small marketing team that works as one. Our creative lead sets the brand and the big ideas. Our GTM engineer knows every company in our market and what it’s doing. A new performance marketeer distributes what you make. And every day, you’ll work closely with sales and customer success.

🧑‍💻 Your mission

Make Payflip the one and only trusted source of Belgian HR managers and CFOs, and the AI tools they use, turn to on salary, benefits and payroll, and turn that into a pipeline. Concretely, your job is threefold:

  • Build the AI content system.

  • Create content that converts, at volume.

  • Arm sales and customer success.

To be clear: this is not just a copywriting role. Together with our creative lead, who owns the brand and the creative direction, you’ll set the bar for what content at Payflip can be, whether it’s a billboard, a video or a publishable salary bible.

After 12 months, we’d love to see:

  • An AI content system in daily use, with production time per asset down and nothing that reads like generic AI content

  • Every long-format piece (webinar, event, e-book) turned into a series of video and static snippets

  • A reliable publishing rhythm, with ad variants delivered at the pace of the testing calendar

  • Measurably better conversion, with download rates, landing page conversion and ad click-through up, and every win or loss documented

  • Original Payflip content (benchmarks, tools, calculators) built on our own data and used for lead generation and by our colleagues

  • Sales and customer success using the case studies, one-pagers and decks you made

🌟 About you

You would be a good fit with our team if most of this sounds like you:

  • 3 to 6 years in growth or content marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or another fast-growing company. You’ve grown organic or paid traffic or leads, and you can show the numbers.

  • AI-native. You’ve built workflows that multiply output, not just used chat tools. You can judge what AI produces on accuracy and tone, which matters a lot when the topic is someone’s salary.

  • You produce for conversion. The hook, the offer, the call to action, the landing page: you know what makes someone take the next step. You read the numbers to see why one version beat another.

  • You find the original angle. Give you a dataset, a customer call or a salary expert, and you come back with a story people want to share.

  • Multi-format. You make short videos, carousels, podcast and webinar clips and simple calculators with AI tools and templates, with an eye for what looks on-brand. You adapt rather than design from scratch.

  • High ownership. You own results, not just output, and propose what to make next based on data rather than waiting for a brief.

  • Reliable and team-minded. You deliver what you promise, put the team’s success first and thrive on feedback.

  • Fluent in Dutch and English.

Can’t tick every box? No worries. Above all we value a high internal drive, curiosity and strong potential: convincing us of this in the hiring process is guaranteed to make you a Payflip’er!

👋 About us

Payflip's mission is to thoroughly shake up the Belgian compensation landscape. Do you have health insurance, group insurance, a company car, a bike lease, meal vouchers, and a flex plan spread across six different tools? And an incomprehensible monthly payslip in yet another one?

Gone are these days. Enter: Payflip's salary super app.

One platform, all salary stuff. That way, every employee truly has their salary in their own hands, and an employer wastes less time on fragmented admin. The result? More focus on the team's financial literacy. Without administrative headaches for the HR team.

We're a young, fast-growing start-up. A quirky bunch of software developers, product designers, account executives, support specialists & customer success managers. Joining the Payflip community means becoming part of a tight-knit team where you can take on clear responsibilities and grow with the organization. Let's put it this way: a Payflip'er smells the opportunity of ownership from miles away!

💜 Payflip's Culture

Our company culture revolves around 3 pillars:

Transparency. We are 100% transparent with everything that happens in the company. We tell each other everything. There is not even one Google Drive file in our archive that is not accessible for all.

Eagerness to learn. You have at least 1 day per month dedicated to learning. Together with your team, you investigate market trends or fix company inefficiencies you choose yourself.

Ownership. As we are a growing team, we'd better all make our hands dirty if we want to step up our game. In order to thrive, you will have to come out of your comfort zone and take up responsibilities, just like all of us.

At Payflip, everyone is an entrepreneur! And because we walk the talk, each team member receives meaningful equity of the company. Growing together at its best!

💰 What's in it for you

We want to remain true to our mission and therefore provide the most optimized salary package in the Belgian SME market. You will receive:

  • A transparent salary based on your impact (check our salary grid here)

  • Meaningful equity (stock options)

  • Top-notch flexible reward plan

  • The Alan healthcare package

  • Meal vouchers (through Payflip, of course) and eco vouchers

  • A mobility budget or company car

  • Remote work as much as you prefer: our office is opposite Brussels Central Station, but we also offer coworking in Antwerp (Silversquare) and Ghent (Wintercircus)

  • Home office compensation

  • An L&D budget so you can further develop yourself

  • Workation? You get a generous remote working budget for coworking spaces in Belgium and abroad!

Payflip uses an open salary grid and for this vacancy we're aiming to hire for the B1 range.

job.title: Head of Digital Push Marketing & Personalization (m/w/d)
job.description:
Worum es in dieser Rolle geht

Als Head of Digital Push Marketing & Personalization (m/w/d) verantwortest du die strategische, operative und technologische Weiterentwicklung unserer digitalen Push-Produkte. Du führst ein schlagkräftiges Team, steuerst ein umsatzrelevantes Portfolio und entwickelst Newsletter, Mobile Push sowie zukünftige Kommunikationskanäle zu hoch personalisierten, automatisierten und datengetriebenen Produkten weiter. Gemeinsam mit Data-, Product- und Tech-Teams gestaltest du die Zukunft der digitalen Kundenkommunikation bei PAYBACK – von intelligenter Personalisierung bis hin zu KI-gestützten und agentic-commerce-fähigen Kommunikationsformaten.

Dein Arbeitsalltag

  • Du verantwortest die strategische, operative und technologische Weiterentwicklung unserer Digital-Push-Produkte Newsletter und Mobile Push sowie perspektivisch weiterer Kanäle wie WhatsApp, SMS, RCS oder In-App-Kommunikation
  • Du führst und entwickelst dein Team und verantwortest ein skalierbares Operating Model für hohe Kampagnenvolumina, effiziente Prozesse sowie exzellente Umsetzungsqualität
  • Du steuerst ein umsatzrelevantes Portfolio und entwickelst unsere Kommunikationsprodukte entlang von Kundennutzen, Partneranforderungen, Performance und Wirtschaftlichkeit kontinuierlich weiter
  • Du treibst Personalisierung und Hyperpersonalisierung für deine Kanäle voran und entwickelst intelligente Zielgruppen-, Angebots-, Kontakt- und Ausspielungslogiken über alle relevanten Kanäle hinweg
  • Du etablierst datengetriebene Testing-, Lern- und Optimierungsprozesse und verbesserst kontinuierlich KPIs wie Reichweite, Engagement, Conversion, Umsatzbeitrag und Kundenbindung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Data, IT, Product, Analytics, Sales und externen Partnern zusammen und bewertest neue Technologien, KI-Anwendungen sowie Potenziale rund um Agentic Commerce und Marketing Automation

Diese Rolle passt gut zu dir, wenn...

  • Du mehrjährige fundierte wie relevante Erfahrung in CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Automation, E-Mail-Marketing, Mobile Push oder einem vergleichbaren digitalen Umfeld mitbringst
  • Du Führungserfahrung besitzt und Teams, Stakeholder sowie komplexe Projekte erfolgreich in einer Matrixorganisation steuern und weiterentwickeln kannst
  • Du Erfahrung mit datengetriebenem Marketing, Performance-Steuerung sowie der kommerziellen Verantwortung für relevante Kampagnen- oder Produktportfolios hast
  • Du fundiertes Know-how in (Hyper-)Personalisierung, Segmentierung, Automatisierung, A/B-Testing und CRM-KPIs mitbringst und digitale Kommunikationskanäle als skalierbare Produkte verstehst
  • Du ein gutes technisches Verständnis für CRM-, Campaign-Management- oder Marketing-Automation-Systeme besitzt und idealerweise Kenntnisse in Datenmodellen, Tracking oder Consent Management mitbringst
  • Du analytisch und unternehmerisch denkst, strategische Zielbilder in pragmatische Roadmaps übersetzen kannst und dich für Themen wie KI, Hyperpersonalisierung und Agentic Commerce begeisterst

Rahmenbedingungen & Benefits

  • Flexibilität: 30 Tage Urlaub und Möglichkeit von Urlaubszukauf, hybrides Arbeiten (2 Tage Homeoffice/Woche), Möglichkeit von Sabbatical
  • Verpflegung: Größtenteils kostenfreie, gesunde und abwechslungsreiche Verpflegung, täglich frisches Obst und Popcorn, Getränke wie Kaffee und Tee inklusive
  • Gesundheit & Fitness: Kostenfreie Nutzung des eigenen Fitnessstudios, Gesundheitswochen, Massagen und Physio-Behandlungen vor Ort
  • Kultur: Team-Events, Social Days und eine offene „Come as you are“-Mentalität, Hunde willkommen, Female Leadership Engagement
  • Entwicklung: Individuelle Trainings- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Teams und übergreifend
  • Mobilität: Übernahme vom Deutschlandticket, zentraler Standort und U-Bahn direkt vor der Tür, Jobrad-Leasing

Warum PAYBACK?

PAYBACK ist das führende Loyalty-Programm in Deutschland und eine der größten datengetriebenen Marketingplattformen weltweit. Unsere Lösungen erreichen Millionen von Menschen - jeden Tag.

Mit über 1000 Mitarbeitenden am Standort München entwickeln wir alle technischen Lösungen selbst und verbinden Daten, Technologie und Marketing, um messbaren Mehrwert zu schaffen. Dich erwarten interdisziplinäre Teams, echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten und eine offene, innovationsgetriebene Kultur.

Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

PAYBACK schätzt Vielfalt - come as you are

job.title: Sales Enablement Specialist
job.description:
About Us

At One10, we are more than just a workplace; we are a community of individuals who share a common belief – the belief in better products and, equally important, the belief in a better you.


Believe in Better Solutions: We take pride in the work we do because we believe in the transformative powers of innovation and recognition. Our commitment to excellence drives us to create solutions that go beyond the ordinary, solutions that have a positive impact on the lives of our customers and clients. Joining One10 means contributing to a culture of continuous improvement, where each day is an opportunity to push boundaries, challenge the status quo, and redefine what's possible. We believe in crafting solutions that make a difference and in setting new standards for quality and ingenuity.


Believe in a Better You: At One10, we recognize that our greatest asset is our people. We are committed to fostering an environment that empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. We believe that by investing in your growth and well-being, we collectively strengthen our ability to achieve greatness. From tailored development programs to a supportive and inclusive culture, we are dedicated to providing the resources and encouragement needed for you to become the best version of yourself. Your success is not just a professional goal; it's our shared commitment.


Job Description


The Sales Enablement Manager is responsible for deploying programs and initiatives that enable selling teams to execute the core aspects of their jobs more effectively, especially as it relates to sales and revenue performance. This role serves as a key resource supporting efforts to earn new business and develop strategies to grow and retain key accounts. Using a consultative approach, The Sales Enablement Manager will seek to deeply understand client objectives and business challenges while applying in-depth knowledge of the industry and One10 products to develop solutions.


Job Description Details:


Scope of Work

  • Oversees the development of current and new enablement initiatives. This may include the programmatic and proposal design of these programs that will pave the way for their successful delivery to revenue teams.
  • Provides insight and support to sales that helps tell a compelling One10 story.
  • Responds to customer concerns and recommends the best solutions for their needs.
  • Facilitates cross-functional team alignment by gathering insights and collaborating to execute initiatives that improve upon existing sales processes, and ultimately align to broader company goals.
  • Creates compelling and distinctive presentations. Sales enablement requires a balance of effective writing, aesthetic and solutioning. This role collaborates with sales engineers, salespeople, solution practitioners and more to ensure that RFPs, proposals, and presentations are innovative, creative, and delivered in the most effective manner for the buyer.
  • Oversee multiple projects and initiatives including execution.
  • Demonstrates a keen familiarity with the buyer’s journey as it evolves alongside the market.
  • Open to modifying approaches based on the ever-changing sales enablement landscape.
  • Identifies the internal stakeholders that are necessary for the success of initiatives.
  • Ensures timely execution of projects.

Additional Job Description Details


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 5 years of experience in presale, sales enablement, or sales support with demonstrated knowledge of best practices, methodologies, and technologies in each of these areas.
  • Measurable experience of having a positive impact on business outcomes, such as win rate, quota attainment, length of sales cycle, etc.
  • Experience in executing change management initiatives with established approaches.
  • Active involvement and participation in industry associations.
  • Ability to streamline processes and existing operations to maximize resource utilization.
  • Masters of the tools in their tech stack, communicating their functionality while also designing initiatives that support their adoption and track their usage.
  • Be adept at strategizing the initiatives that will have the highest impact given available resources and be able to leverage their organizational skills to anticipate roadblocks, juggle priorities, and meet completion deadlines.
  • Able to prime sales teams for changes by providing them with the necessary tools, content and support to meet and guide their end-customers throughout the various stages of their journey.


#LI-Remote

Maximum Base Pay


$75,000-$85,000

job.title: Sales Executive Senior Director
job.description:
Onbe, a fast-growing FinTech, bringing innovation to a rapidly growing global marketplace, stands for “on behalf.” Because that’s exactly how we work: on behalf of our clients, as their comprehensive payments partner. We transform the way payments are imagined — as an opportunity for innovation, a source of insight to customers, and a way to connect with partners around the globe!

Summary:  Onbe seeks an impactful Sales Executive Senior Director  to establish new, high potential partnerships with channel partners in the financial services space. Leveraging our global reach and proprietary technology, this role will help establish partnerships and partner models that deliver scaled distribution to Onbe and value to our partners in their efforts to retain, grow and expand their customer base. Our solutions focus on payments to consumers, workforces, and service providers, including refunds, rewards, and payroll delivered digitally and physically. The ideal candidate will possess deep industry knowledge, excel in relationship building, strategic thinking, and negotiation. Key responsibilities include identifying high fit/high potential new partners, leading deal teams, navigating complex negotiations, defining partnership priorities and key KPIs, and launching the relationship to maximize value for both parties. Reporting to senior leadership, the candidate will ensure alignment with organizational priorities and drive mutual growth. 

This role is a hybrid role that will work onsite 2 days per week at our Conshohocken, PA location. Occasional travel may be required as part of this position. 

Responsibilities: 

Develop a target list of high fit/high potential new partnerships; manage a diverse pipeline and secure new partners in support of Onbe’s channel distribution strategy. 

Establish relationships with multiple partner stakeholders; build trust and uncover organizational priorities, operating structures and decision-making criteria. 

Assemble and lead deal teams; based on a deep understanding of partner’s priorities and decision-making processes, define and articulate win strategies to execute a successful organizational selling motion. 

In line with partner priorities and go-to-market practices, ensure partner is equipped with scalable pricing models and product options.

Lead pricing and contracting negotiations; architect meaningful incentive structures to motivate partner to drive volume.

Develop partnership plans to ensure alignment between partner and Onbe: document mutually identified revenue goals, priorities, resources, roles & responsibilities and KPIs.

Bring Onbe resources (e.g., project management, channel marketing, relationship management, etc.) to the field to set the partnership up for long-term success. Provide oversight and ensure successful launch of partnership through pilot.

With a land & expand mindset, uncover additional opportunities for Onbe to add value within the partner ecosystem or via referrals; win opportunities across new buying centers and nurture a network/referral effect to extend the value of the partnership.

Qualifications: 

10+ years in a consultative B2B2C sales role  

Experience in payments and disbursements preferred. 

Familiarity with the refunds, incentive or rewards spaces is a plus. 

Demonstrated ability to sell to multiple C-level personas, including finance, marketing and digital engagement personas. 

Must display excellent verbal and written presentation, interpersonal and communication skills. 

Experience working with a CRM such as Microsoft Dynamics or Salesforce 

Up to 20% domestic travel may be required 

The base salary range for this position is between $159,480.00 to $178,500.00 plus commission. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of proven experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, business needs, and market demand. Our competitive benefits include medical, dental, vision, wellness, 401(k) matching, open paid time off, generous parental leave, and more! Our job titles may span more than one career level. All candidates are encouraged to apply. #li-hybrid

At Onbe, a diverse group of people, ideas, and perspectives are key to achieving phenomenal things. For over 25 years, our focus has remained on building a culture of openness and ingenuity, where employees come together to innovate and build disbursement solutions that make the lives of our clients and their consumers and workforces easier and better. Our definition of success includes celebrating differences and affirming belonging. To that end, we ask employees to come to Onbe as they are and contribute their diverse perspectives, identities, and experiences.

We believe that the recruiting phase is only the very beginning of diversity and inclusion. At Onbe, we’re constantly evolving the way we celebrate diversity every day and in everything we do. With several internal committees that are dedicated to mental and physical wellness, diversity, inclusion, and community outreach, we are committed to making a culture that is inclusive to all.

Onbe is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek out ways to create a mindful workforce that embraces diversity and celebrates a culture of inclusion. We do not discriminate against employees or job applicants on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), gender identity, sexual orientation, marital or family status, religion, age, disability, genetic information or military service. Our equal opportunity policy applies to all decisions of employment including hiring, placement, promotion or advancement, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, compensation, training and leaves of absence

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
