job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Customer Success Manager | NeoDay | Tilburg
🔹 Location: Tilburg (On-site 80% / Remote 20%)
🔹 Type: Full-time
🔹 Experience: Mid to senior level (4–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or CRM / Loyalty Marketing)

About NeoDay

For decades, loyalty programs meant endless IT projects and ROI "somewhere in year three." We think that's broken, so we're proving the opposite. At NeoDay, we help retailers and consumer brands, from supermarkets and fashion chains to fast food and fuel stations, turn loyalty into a real growth engine. Our platform combines AI-driven personalization, gamification and ready-to-launch apps, so brands like Tesco, Action and La Place can go live in weeks instead of years.

NeoDay is the award-winning loyalty platform. We won Best Retail Loyalty Program Worldwide at the International Loyalty Awards and were named by Forrester among the world's leading loyalty platforms. Everything we build is made in-house in The Netherlands and the Philippines, and we're scaling fast across Europe and beyond.

Your role

A loyalty program isn't won on launch day. It's won in the months after: every new member, every campaign that lands, every euro of uplift on the client's books. When our clients succeed, NeoDay grows with them. You're the one who makes that happen.

As Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of our international brands from go-live onwards. You become an extension of their marketing team: the loyalty expert at the table who knows what to launch next, why it will work, and how to prove it did. Strategy, results, and a story your client can take straight to their board. You report to our Head of Customer Success and work hand-in-hand with our Solution Architects, Sales, Product, Data and Support teams.

What you'll do

  • Own your book: Be the go-to partner for a portfolio of international brands, from the loyalty manager running campaigns to the C-suite signing off on budget.

  • Define what winning looks like: Set clear goals and a proper baseline with every client, and turn them into a Success Plan you both steer on.

  • Make value impossible to ignore: Deliver campaign results, impact snapshots and benchmarks that your champions share with their leadership. The kind of numbers that get forwarded to the CEO with "have you seen this?"

  • Lead the strategic conversation: Run QBRs, shape the marketing and campaign calendar, and bring loyalty ideas that grow members, visit frequency and basket size.

  • Grow the program, grow the account: Drive adoption and the growth built into every contract. Spot expansion opportunities early and team up with Sales to land them.

  • Never rely on one champion: Map stakeholders, build relationships across marketing, IT and leadership, and make NeoDay part of how the whole organization works.

  • Be the Voice of the Customer: Bundle client feedback into sharp input for Product and bring the roadmap back to your clients. You know when to say "yes," when to say "not now," and how to say "no" so it still lands well.

  • Raise the bar for Customer Success: Help set the standard for how NeoDay partners with its clients. You bring best practices, sharpen how we work and make excellence the norm in every account.

What you bring

  • Experience: 4–7 years in Customer Success, Account Management or client-side CRM / loyalty marketing, ideally at a SaaS or martech company working with retail or consumer brands.

  • A marketer at heart: You speak the language of CMOs and loyalty managers. Campaigns, segments, member lifecycles and promo calendars are your home turf.

  • Data into stories: Baselines, uplift, retention. You're at home in a dashboard and you know which number matters to the board.

  • Trusted advisor: Confident in front of C-level, honest when expectations need resetting, calm when things get hectic.

  • Commercial instinct: You spot growth opportunities before the client does, and you build the business case that turns them into a yes, together with Sales.

  • Client champion: You genuinely care about your clients' success. You listen closely, act before they have to ask and build relationships that feel like partnerships.

  • Languages: Fluent in written and spoken English. Dutch is a bonus.

What you'll get

  • A competitive base salary plus an OTE component: you grow the accounts, you share in the upside.

  • 25 vacation days (based on a full-time contract).

  • A laptop and phone subscription compensation.

  • An international role with a portfolio of leading brands and real commercial impact.

  • Travel allowance / NS card.

  • Great colleagues, team events, and an informal Brabant-style culture: we perform together and enjoy together!

Why NeoDay?

NeoDay combines the energy of a scale-up with decades of combined loyalty experience. We're scaling from a handful of flagship partnerships to a customer base across Europe and beyond, and Customer Success is where that growth is won. You'll get clear goals, real ownership and the freedom to build it your way. If you want to be the reason great brands keep growing, we want to talk to you.

job.title: Corporate Business Developer
job.description:
Monizze is on a mission to help employers support the well-being and engagement of their people.
From our roots in electronic meal, eco, and gift vouchers, we’ve evolved into a comprehensive Reward Management System, offering smart, flexible, and human-centered salary solutions.

To further strengthen our position in the premium segment of the market, we are looking for a driven and commercially strong Corporate Business Developer.

Are you a motivated business developer who thrives on winning leading corporate clients? Do you effortlessly identify strategic opportunities and act as a fully fledged sparring partner at C-level? Then this could be the perfect next step in your career.

Your advantages first

💪 Your purchasing power is optimized – the motto is true for clients & employees
🌴 30 days off per year: 20 legal holidays + 6 ADV/RTT + 4 Monidayzz
🚙 A company car
🏠 Homeworking flexibility with days of remote work and a monthly allowance to make it comfy
🌍 Work from abroad up to 4 weeks a year (after 6 months @ Monizze)
🧇 Belgian roots, mindset & attitude: a cool and informal atmosphere – one of the best things since waffles
🚀 Disrupting and innovative: we digitalized the market and keep pushing innovation in every aspect
🧠 Your growth is our growth: unlimited learning opportunities (languages, personal growth, hard skills,...)
👪 Your health and your family's health is covered by our hospitalization insurance
✨ Internal mobility is regularly an option for anyone looking to evolve or change jobs or departments
🏠 Homeworking opportunities and overall flexibility
🧳 A yearly trip with all your colleagues to celebrate our achievements
➕ We do much more for our employees, but we needed space to describe the job! We'd love to tell you about it though, so ask us!

Key Responsibilities

As Corporate Business Developer, you will be a driving force behind our growth in the corporate segment. Your focus will be on large companies with more than 1,000 employees. You will act as a strategic partner to these organisations, helping them optimise their remuneration policies and employee benefits strategies.

In addition to developing direct corporate business, you will play a key role in identifying, building and expanding strategic partnerships that strengthen Monizze’s position in the market. This includes developing relationships with professional networks, industry organisations and ecosystem partners, such as our existing partnership with Federgon.

  • High-level hunting: Strategically map the corporate market and open doors with the right stakeholders. Targeted social selling, smart networking at C-level events and highly personalised outreach campaigns will be central to your approach.

  • Strategic consulting: Engage with HR Directors, Compensation & Benefits Managers, CFOs and CEOs. Understand their challenges and translate them into smart solutions in the areas of salary optimisation and employee benefits.

  • Build lasting relationships: Your relationship-building skills are one of your greatest assets. You will develop a strong and sustainable network within the corporate world and position yourself as a trusted expert.

  • Develop strategic partnerships: Identify relevant partners and create mutually valuable collaborations with professional federations, industry organisations and other key players in the HR and business ecosystem. You will further develop existing partnerships, such as Federgon, and explore new opportunities that generate commercial value and strengthen Monizze’s market presence.

  • Close the deal: Manage the entire sales process, from the first introduction to pricing negotiations and the final signature.

  • Spot market trends: Keep your finger on the pulse of the HR world and share valuable insights with our internal teams to further improve our products and services.

  • Represent Monizze externally: Act as an ambassador for Monizze at industry events, networking opportunities and partner meetings, helping to increase our visibility and credibility within the corporate market.

Qualifications

We are looking for a strategic thinker with strong influencing skills and sharp business insights. You have the maturity to manage complex sales cycles and combine in-depth expertise with a consultative approach at C-level.

  • Corporate sales expertise: You are results-oriented, proactive and have a proven track record in B2B sales, preferably within the large enterprise segment.

  • Natural networker: You have excellent interpersonal skills and can communicate effectively at different levels. You feel equally comfortable in boardrooms and at networking events.

  • Partnership mindset: You know how to identify, develop and manage strategic partnerships that create value for all parties. You are skilled at building relationships with industry organisations, professional federations and other influential stakeholders.

  • HR expertise: You have in-depth knowledge of HR processes, remuneration policies and salary optimisation in Belgium. You understand how to create value for both employers and employees.

  • Multilingual professional: You are fluent in Dutch, French and English. You can present, advise and negotiate convincingly in all three languages.

  • Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in business development.

  • Professional autonomy: You work independently in a corporate environment, proactively manage your own agenda and pipeline, and move smoothly between strategic thinking and operational execution.

Join Monizze in this exciting phase of growth and be a key player in shaping the future of our business. Apply now to be part of a dynamic team and contribute to the success of Monizze in the corporate solutions market.

job.title: Account Executive - APAC
job.description:
Marsello helps retailers know their customers and keep them coming back. We're growing across APAC, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us win the next wave of retail brands.

You'll begin with a real head start. There's a steady flow of inbound leads from retailers who already want to talk. The challenge, and the fun, is going out and finding the ones who don't know about us yet. You'll convert inbound interest, build your own pipeline through outbound, and run demos that uncover needs retailers didn't know they had. You'll do it alongside a supportive, high-energy sales team that's in your corner.

If you know your way around SaaS, love the chase as much as the close, and want targets you can actually beat with a product retailers genuinely need, this is a role where you'll have the leads to hit your number and the freedom to smash it.

What you'll own

  • Inbound that's ready to go. Retailers come to us looking for a better way to keep their customers coming back. You'll pick up those leads, qualify them quickly, and turn warm interest into signed customers.
  • Outbound that's yours to grow. Beyond the inbound flow, you'll go after the retailers who should be on Marsello but aren't yet. You'll decide who to target, start the conversation, and build a pipeline that wouldn't exist without you. This is where great AEs make their mark.
  • The first conversation. For most prospective customers, you'll be their first real experience of Marsello. You'll run the demos, present the product, and ask the questions that get to what a retailer actually needs.
  • Your numbers. You'll carry a target and be trusted to hit it, and then to beat it, with a sales team that shares what works and celebrates the wins.

What we're looking for

  • A proven sales track record of hitting and beating targets, ideally in SaaS, retail, loyalty or marketing.
  • The discipline to work inbound leads quickly and well, and the drive to build outbound pipelines from scratch.
  • Natural confidence presenting and running demos online.
  • A tidy, well-run pipeline in a CRM.
  • A strong appreciation for technology, ideally marketing automation, cloud or SaaS, and genuine curiosity about how retailers use digital and marketing tools.
  • Excellent communication, both in writing and out loud.
  • A team-first attitude. You want to be part of a high-velocity sales team, not just a solo operator.

Why Marsello

We're a smart, close-knit team spread across New Zealand, Canada and Australia, and we back people to own their space. This role is remote, ideally based in Wellington.

Beyond the work itself, you'll get genuine flexibility in your working day, subsidised Southern Cross healthcare, a wellness allowance, a technology allowance, and even a day off for your birthday.

If you want a sales role with warm leads to work, new ground to break, and a team that has your back, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Product Owner / Business Analyst
job.description:
Years of Experience Required

4+ years of overall professional experience as a BA, PO, or of similar job experience

Basic Job Description

Review, analyze and evaluate MI's Recognition, Incentive and Engagement web portals. Use creativity and strategy to meet client/product needs and document requirements, define objectives, and formulate solutions to support overall business strategies (75% of role). Rely on experience in working with clients, partners, and internal teams to drive strategic corporate initiatives and help guide software development projects from initiation to deployment, including front-end testing of the designed solution (25% of role).

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Work with internal teams to prioritize and define modifications to MI's multi-tenant Incentive web application
  • Guide the design of MI's multi-tenant applications
  • Make decisions off market research and data insight to define the future vision of our applications
  • Strategize with clients on their web application change requests and bridge the gap between the client and internal web developers
  • Oversee the stages of a product's lifecycle from design through development
  • Ability to understand the customer's particular program and technical needs to position and document a solution mix which best addresses their needs
  • Participate in account strategy sessions with the intent of developing system recommendations
  • Work closely with other BAs, Web Developers, and Product Owners to formulate a product's launch or solution change
  • Tackle challenges and new findings in the midst of a sprint
  • Assist in front-end web testing of your designed solution
  • Support responses and solutions to client RFIs/RFPs
  • Ability to demonstrate and communicate the value of the product solution, not just document the functional requirements
  • Be resourceful and creative, consider how existing solutions might be combined to engender new sales opportunities
  • Support MI-specific value proposition hypotheses that clearly articulates 'why MI?' and 'why now?'
  • Present solution roadmap information to customers and prospects

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required

  • Builds a strong working relationship with both the prospect and the MI teams
  • Portrays communication skills to meet business needs through phone conversations, written communication, and face to face meetings
  • Quickly understands the business issues and data challenges of a client's organization and industry
  • Use problem solving to work through and communicate roadblocks
  • Leads team meetings on a designed solution
  • Deliver informative, well-organized presentations based on business needs
  • Thoroughly understands MI's products to participate in prospect demos
  • Take input from others and be able to accurately apply it to the solution
  • Consistently delivers high-quality services to our clients
  • Be fluent in using web sites across many browsers/devices
  • Feel comfortable using Excel, Word, SnagIt, etc, to create a client-facing, professional requirements document with detailed mock-ups
  • Possesses understanding in the areas of application programming, database and system design (preferred, not required)
  • Ensure multi-platform and multi-device (PC, mobile & tablet) UI/UX responsive design
  • Exhibit confidence and an extensive knowledge of emerging industry practices, when solving business problems
  • Push creative thinking beyond the boundaries of existing industry practices and client mindsets

job.title: Operations Manager, Onsite Events
job.description:
Where Human Connection Fuels Possibility ​

At Maritz, decades of innovation and perseverance have built more than just a strong reputation — they’ve shaped a culture where human connection and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. ​

Joining Maritz means becoming part of a workplace grounded in a critical truth; people and their potential is our greatest resource.

​

Maritz helps companies achieve their business goals by inspiring people to perform their best. We design experiences, incentives, and recognition programs that spark action and deliver measurable impact.​

And we’ve brought this human-first design inward – intentionally building teams that care for each other and collaborate powerfully. In our most recent employee survey, nearly 90% of respondents said that their managers care about their concerns and 82% said they feel genuinely appreciated. We know that when employees feel seen, supported, and celebrated for who they are, they thrive and so does our business. ​

That’s why we’ve created a flexible, environment that empowers you to do your best work without sacrificing what matters most to you. In fact, in that same survey, nearly 90% of respondents said they have the flexibility they need to balance work and personal life and nearly 80% said Maritz does a great job prioritizing employee well being.​

We have a passion for excellence and genuine care for the people making it possible.

The Operations Manager, Onsite Events directs and coaches the activities of assigned team members to ensure all customer service levels and deliverables are achieved.

This role also provides comprehensive leadership to a dedicated client, overseeing sourcing and planning of programs, providing client and team support and training, and managing special projects.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Direct and support assigned team members in sourcing, planning, and executing client meetings and events.
  • Lead team meetings to review productivity, deliverables, and service levels while promoting best practices and industry trends.
  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) to ensure consistency and training across the team. Works 1:1 with employees to identify areas of improvement, growth and opportunities. Reviews, tracks and/or approves vacation time, expense reports, payroll, time and other employee systems for direct reports
  • Participate in client meetings to review operational processes, resolve challenges, and maintain satisfaction.
  • Manage relationships with service partners (Catering, Facilities, AV, Security, Transportation, etc.) to ensure alignment and quality.
  • Oversee implementation of SOPs, process improvements, and metric tracking for assigned teams.
  • Manage special projects and provide backup support for the Director of Operations as needed.

What You’ll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in meeting/event planning or hotel catering/convention sales.
  • Strong knowledge of event program management and budget maintenance.
  • Proven ability to lead teams and projects, including coaching and developing direct reports.
  • Experience building and maintaining client relationships while managing multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.
  • Proficiency in G Suite and ability to learn new technology quickly.

Nice To Have

  • CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) Certification.
  • Prior experience in incentive, association, or corporate event planning.
  • Prior experience leading direct reports.
  • Background in promoting organizational change and efficiency.

Working Logistics & Things You Should Know

  • This is a full time, 40 hours per week, salaried position. Your working hours will flex and adapt to event needs, but they'll generally fall within Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM timeframe. Because of the nature of events, occasional work outside these hours, including early mornings, late evenings, and weekends, may be required. Your manager will work with you to ensure your schedule is balanced.
  • Employees are responsible for securing their own reliable transportation to and from work, including for early morning, late evening, or off-hour shifts that may fall outside of GBus availability (where GBus is available). While GBus is a valuable employee perk, it should not be relied upon as the sole method of commuting, as it may not accommodate all event schedules.
  • The total compensation range for this position is $100,000–$120,000, based on experience and qualifications. Compensation for internal candidates will be reviewed in accordance with our internal compensation practices.
  • This role may be located in one of the following locations: Sunnyvale, San Bruno, or Mountain View.

DISCLAIMER: This job description is designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by associates within this classification. It is not designed to confirm or be interpreted as a comprehensive summary of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of associates assigned to this job.

At Maritz, decades of innovation and perseverance have built more than just a strong reputation — they’ve shaped a culture where human connection and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. ​

job.title: Delivery Manager
job.description:
We are looking for a new Delivery Manager for our projects department. The Delivery Manager is responsible for the Belgium cluster within our projects department of P&C, our Insurance business unit. As a Delivery Manager you are end-to-end responsible for the project delivery for a group of customers located in Belgium, you are the people manager for the committed experts within the cluster and you are also responsible for the revenue, costs and project profitability for all customers in the cluster.

Together with the other Delivery Managers this role is also responsible, for securing best practices in the Delivery P&C teams. You will need to work close together with the other Delivery Managers and DevOps Managers for a necessary prioritization in both customers and employee needs. The manager reports directly to Charles Clarke.

Key about your responsibilities

  • End-to-end responsible for all projects in the cluster;
  • Responsible for people management for a cluster (15+ employees);
  • Profit & Loss responsible of the cluster;
  • Participates in steering committees of customers within cluster;
  • Networking and customer contact on operational and tactical level.

Keylane offers

  • A monthly gross salary between € 5.100 and € 8.000 based on 40 hours per week;
  • 8% holiday allowance of your total gross salary;
  • A profit share, which is about one month salary on an annual base;
  • Travel reimbursement: a NS Business card or mileage allowance (€ 0.23 per km);
  • 24 holiday days (with the option to buy extra) and 7 inclusion days, which can be exchanged with fixed Dutch national holidays, allowing you to take them when you like;
  • A pension scheme, with the option to save extra;
  • A comprehensive vitality offer to help you stay healthy;
  • A one-year contract that, subject to satisfactory performance, will be converted into a permanent contract;
  • Flexibility in working environment. As part of a hybrid working team, you will work partly from home and partly from the office. If you work in the office, a free lunch is waiting for you every day. If you work from home, you will receive a working from home allowance (€ 4 net per day) and internet allowance (€ 35 net per month);
  • The possibility of working remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year;
  • The opportunity to develop yourself at our Academy through courses and training, both professionally and personally;
  • An active and fun community of ‘Keylaners’. We also have after work drinks at our in-house pub every Thursday.

Key about you

  • You are skilled at leading and motivating your team. Capable of setting clear expectations, providing guidance and career opportunities.
  • Committed to understanding and meeting your customer needs. You are capable of building strong customer relationships and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • You are proficient in project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure. Able to create project plans with your team, allocate resources, and track progress against milestones.
  • Capable of identifying issues, analysing data, and making informed decisions to address challenges and keep projects on track.
  • You have experience or affinity with maintaining an accurate and up-to-date financial administration, ensuring that all transactions are recorded and invoiced timely and correctly.

Speaking the Dutch language (near fluently) is mandatory for this role.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Voor deze functie staan drie van onze SaaS-platformen centraal: Plexus, LeanApps en Lifetime. We implementeren deze platformen zelf bij onze klanten. Omdat we de komende jaren groei verwachten in onze implementatieprojecten op het gebied van levensverzekeringen en pensioenen, zijn we op zoek naar een ervaren projectmanager.

About Your Role

Je wordt verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van onze platformen bij bestaande en nieuwe klanten, waarbij vaak een complexe datamigratie hoort. Het betreft omvangrijke trajecten die geregeld meerdere jaren lopen met internationale samenwerking en lokale implementatie. Je komt in een hecht team van projectmanagers met veel ervaring in de Life & Pension markt, waarin iedereen elkaar helpt om het resultaat te bereiken. Daarnaast zal je uiteraard sturing geven aan het projectteam, wat bestaat uit consultants met ieder hun eigen specialisme.

About Your Team

Als projectmanager ben je samen met vele gedreven en ervaren collega’s onderdeel van onze Life & Pension Delivery afdeling. Deze afdeling vormt de schakel tussen onze klanten en onze productorganisatie, met afdelingen in Nederland, Denemarken en India, maar ook de organisatie die de infrastructuren organiseert en beheert. Je werkt in een projectteam samengesteld uit diverse expertises (pensioen/verzekeringsinhoudelijk, actuarieel, IT-technisch).

Key about you

  • Afgeronde opleiding op HBO/Academisch niveau, bij voorkeur in een bèta richting.
  • Ervaring als projectmanager in omvangrijke software implementatie / datamigratie trajecten
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden.
  • Werkt gestructureerd en accuraat.
  • Oplossingsgericht, ambitieus en leergierig.
  • Communiceert goed zowel in woord als geschrift.
  • Gewend om onder druk van het behalen van mijlpalen te werken.
  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en goed Engels

Keylane offers

  • Bij aanvang een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 5200 en € 7200 op basis van 40 uur;
  • 8% vakantiegeld;
  • Winstuitkering;
  • Pensioenregeling, met de optie om zelf extra bij te sparen;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding: Ontvang een kilometervergoeding van €0,23 per km of een NS-Business Card, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken;
  • 24 vakantiedagen (met de optie om extra bij te kopen) en 7 inclusieve dagen die inwisselbaar zijn om verlof op te nemen op andere dagen dan nationale feestdagen;
  • Flexibiliteit in werkomgeving. Als hybride werkend team werk je deels op kantoor en deels vanuit huis. Werk je op kantoor, dan staat er elke dag een gratis lunch voor je klaar. Werk je thuis, dan ontvang je een thuiswerkvergoeding (€4,- per dag) en een internetvergoeding (€35,- netto per maand);
  • De mogelijkheid om tot 2 maanden per jaar op afstand vanuit het buitenland te werken;
  • De mogelijkheid om een fiets te leasen via ons fietsleaseprogramma;
  • Een jaarcontract dat bij goed functioneren wordt omgezet in een vast contract;
  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen in onze eigen Academy door middel van cursussen en trainingen, zowel inhoudelijk als op persoonlijk vlak;
  • Een uitgebreid vitaliteitsaanbod om jou te helpen gezond te blijven;
  • Een actieve community van Keylaners. Leer je collega’s op een informele manier leren kennen bij een van de georganiseerde activiteiten. Ook is er elke donderdagmiddag een borrel in onze inhouse kroeg de BaaS.

Keylane Academy

Develop yourself every day! To support our mission to empower the insurance and pension industry with the best solutions and the brightest experts, the Keylane Academy offers extensive career development support for Keylaners at all career levels.

  • Extensive product trainings
  • Courses to understand the insurance & pension industries
  • Access to thousands of e-learning courses via digital platforms
  • Personal development courses
  • Leadership programmes
  • Best in class language courses
  • Consulting track
  • Personal growth and career goals courses
  • And many more

job.title: Sales Executive – Enterprise SaaS
job.description:
We’re looking for a Sales Executive who can own the sales cycle end-to-end — from converting MQLs to SQLs, running demos, and driving closures.

This role is ideal for someone who understands enterprise sales journeys and enjoys working on high-value, consultative deals.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Convert MQLs → SQLs → demos → closures
  • Run product demos and tailor conversations based on client needs
  • Work on enterprise SaaS sales cycles (longer, consultative deals)
  • Engage with decision-makers across functions
  • Collaborate with SDRs/marketing to improve lead quality
  • Maintain pipeline visibility and follow-ups

Our Ideal Candidate:

  • Graduate with 2–3 years of experience in B2B / SaaS sales
  • Experience in enterprise sales cycles
  • Strong understanding of sales funnel (MQL to closure)
  • Good communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to handle demos and client conversations confidently
  • Ownership mindset and ability to drive deals independentl

Good to Have

  • Experience in FinTech / HRTech / Enterprise SaaS
  • Experience dealing with large organizations / multiple stakeholders

What You’ll Get

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise deals
  • Direct exposure to complex sales conversations
  • A fast-growing SaaS environment with real ownership
  • Clear growth path into senior sales roles

Why This Role is Interesting

  • You’re not just closing small deals — you’ll work on enterprise-level problem solving
  • Full ownership of the sales journey, not just a part of it
  • Real learning in consultative selling and SaaS deal cycles

job.title: Accountmanager Compacon
job.description:
Als creatieve sparringpartner helpen we merken op te vallen met verrassende promotionele concepten. Samen met een energiek team van ruim 35 collega’s zetten we ons dagelijks in om onze klanten te voorzien van inspirerende totaaloplossingen. Ben jij een creatieve geest en wil je ons helpen merken nog meer te laten stralen? En ben je op zoek naar een Account Manager rol waar jij jouw creativiteit helemaal kwijt kunt? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Samen met een team ben je verantwoordelijk voor een belangrijke groep key accounts. Met jouw creativiteit, ondernemerschap en commercialiteit slaag jij erin om marketing doelstellingen en onderliggende behoeftes van onze klanten te vertalen naar bijbehorende promotionele oplossing die past bij de wens van de klant. Een aantal voorbeelden van klanten van ons in Nederland zijn Center Parcs, NS, Yamaha en Randstad.

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Het opbouwen en verder uitbouwen van goede klantenrelaties. Je creëert en benut commerciële kansen.
  • Door jouw oprechte nieuwsgierigheid weet je de wensen van de klant goed te achterhalen en weet je deze wens om te zetten naar een perfect passend aanbod.
  • Samen met het projectteam creëer je verrassende en onderscheidende promotionele concepten voor de klanten. Dit blijft niet alleen bij promotionele artikelen, maar je denkt na over een totaaloplossing waarbij je ook kan denken aan bijvoorbeeld een webshop oplossing of een eigen lijn van promotieartikelen voor de klant.
  • Het opstellen en uitvoeren van een commercieel jaarplan voor je klanten.
  • Onderhandelen van prijzen en condities.
  • Forecasting van volume & omzetontwikkeling bij je klanten, bijsturen waar nodig en reporting richting stakeholders.
  • Naast de bestaande klanten ga je actief opzoek naar nieuwe kansen en mogelijkheden om new business te genereren.

Al met al dus een heel gevarieerde rol, waarbij je intensief samenwerkt met collega Account Managers, de commerciële binnendienst en de designers.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je gaat deel uitmaken van het Sales team in Nederland. In dit team werk je samen met 16 collega’s. Samen zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor Compacon in Nederland. Daarnaast werk je vanuit het Compacon hoofdkantoor van Europa, en dit zijn in totaal 35 collega’s die werkzaam zijn vanuit Barendrecht.

Compacon maakt onderdeel uit van Plato Group. Plato Group heeft ruim 80 jaar ervaring in de wereld van promotionele artikelen. Plato Group is overkoepelende organisatie van twee innovatieve en toonaangevende merken in onze branche; IGO Promo en Compacon. We zijn een internationale organisatie met onze hoofdvestiging in Helmond en regiokantoren in diverse Europese landen.

Sociale en ecologische duurzaamheid zijn voor ons een hoge prioriteit. We nemen verschillende maatregelen om onze impact op de planeet te verbeteren en goed te doen voor de samenleving: we doneren een deel van onze winst aan goede doelen en we gaan steeds meer over op duurzame producten. We zijn volop in beweging en een organisatie met enorm veel potentie in de Europese markt. Dit biedt volop kansen aan enthousiaste en talentvolle mensen!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een werkomgeving waar sociale- én ecologische duurzaamheid topprioriteiten zijn. Zo nemen we diverse maatregelen om onze impact op de planeet te verkleinen en bij te dragen aan een betere samenleving. Dit doen we door een deel van onze winst aan goede doelen te doneren, kansen te bieden aan mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt en door steeds meer gebruik te maken van duurzame producten!
  • Een veelzijdige functie waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om mee te helpen bouwen aan een groeiend bedrijf.
  • Een plezierige werkomgeving met fijne collega’s (al zeggen we het zelf ?).
  • Een werkomgeving waar we hard werken maar met tijd voor gezelligheid, teamuitjes en het vieren van successen.
  • Ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van je kwaliteiten, vakkennis en groeipotentie.
  • Een marktconform salaris en een goed secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: goede pensioensregeling, mogelijkheid om thuis te werken en 27 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.

Wat neem je mee?

Als Account Manager ben je enthousiast, ondernemend en hou je van aanpakken. Je bent een doorzetter met een flinke dosis ambitie. Daarnaast is creativiteit enorm belangrijk, je vindt het leuk om out-of-the-box te denken. De kwaliteit in contact met klanten heb je zelf al in huis, je bent een volwaardig gesprekspartner voor onze grote accounts.

Daarnaast neem je het volgende met je mee:

  • Je hebt minimaal een HBO werk- en denkniveau;
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in onze branche óf in een creatieve omgeving.
  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een commerciële functie.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32-40 uur.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een rijbewijs B.

Durf jij het Compacon avontuur aan als Account Manager? Reageer dan zo snel mogelijk door het sollicitatieformulier in te vullen en jouw CV te uploaden. Deze kan gericht worden aan onze HR Business Partner Mariëlle Martens. Voor vragen mag je altijd contact opnemen met Mariëlle via +31 (0)6 48650950 of per e-mail via marielle.martens@platogroup.eu. Wij kijken uit naar jouw reactie!

job.title: Inside Sales Medewerker Internationaal
job.description:
Wat ga je doen

Je gaat onderdeel uitmaken van het IGO Sales & Customer Service team in Helmond, bestaande uit 15 collega’s. Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor klanten uit Nederland, België, Italië, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Ierland. Je werkt dus in een internationale omgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is!

Deze vacature staat open binnen het internationale salesteam, met een sterke focus op de UK- en Ierse markt. Je krijgt de kans om deze markten verder uit te bouwen en commerciële kansen om te zetten in resultaat. Daarnaast ondersteun je ook de commerciële activiteiten in andere internationale markten waarin IGO actief is.

Als Inside Sales Medewerker International ben je verantwoordelijk voor het actief benaderen van klanten, het opstellen en opvolgen van offertes en het verder uitbouwen van bestaande en nieuwe klantrelaties.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de commerciële ontwikkeling van de UK- en Ierse markt.
  • Je benadert actief nieuwe klanten en bouwt bestaande klantrelaties verder uit.
  • Je stelt offertes op, werkt deze uit en volgt ze proactief op.
  • Je begeleidt het volledige commerciële proces, van eerste klantcontact tot en met de levering van de order.
  • Je denkt mee over de mogelijkheden van personalisatie, druktechnieken en productuitvoeringen om de klant het best mogelijke eindresultaat te bieden.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s van Sales, Customer Service, Order Entry, Traffic, Finance en de grafische afdeling om iedere order succesvol af te ronden.
  • Je signaleert commerciële kansen én verbeterpunten in processen en dienstverlening en draagt actief bij aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.
  • Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende internationale markten en communicatiestijlen.

Al met al dus een heel afwisselende commerciële functie waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om initiatief te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. En mocht je ambitieus zijn… dan kun je dat zeker kwijt binnen onze organisatie! Er zijn volop doorgroeimogelijkheden.

Hier kom je terecht

IGO is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een sterke Europese distributeur en online speler in promotionele artikelen. We bieden een volledig geautomatiseerde B2B-webshop, ondersteund door een uitstekend customer service- en sales team. Hierdoor kunnen onze klanten eenvoudig de juiste producten vinden en bestellen. Voor heel IGO in Europa zijn ongeveer 75 collega’s werkzaam.

IGO maakt onderdeel uit van Plato Group. Plato Group heeft ruim 80 jaar ervaring in de wereld van promotionele artikelen. Plato Group is de overkoepelende organisatie van twee innovatieve en toonaangevende merken in onze branche: IGO Promo en Compacon. We zijn een internationale organisatie met onze hoofdvestiging in Helmond en regiokantoren in diverse Europese landen.

Wat neem je mee?

Ervaring is een pré, maar we vinden commerciële drive, enthousiasme, initiatief en de ambitie om jezelf te ontwikkelen minstens zo belangrijk.

  • Je beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je bent commercieel ingesteld en krijgt energie van het benaderen van klanten.
  • Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring in een commerciële binnendienstfunctie.
  • Je beheerst de Engelse taal uitstekend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk (native is een pré).
  • Je bent communicatief sterk, schakelt snel en weet klanten op een enthousiaste manier te overtuigen.
  • Je bent proactief, zelfstandig en houdt ook in drukke periodes het overzicht.
  • Ervaring met internationale markten, ERP-systemen of de grafische branche is een pluspunt.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.

Wat wij bieden

  • Een veelzijdige internationale salesfunctie waarin je veel vrijheid krijgt om mee te helpen bouwen aan een groeiend bedrijf.
  • Een plezierige werkomgeving met fijne collega’s.
  • Een werkomgeving waar we hard werken, maar ook tijd maken voor gezelligheid, teamuitjes en het vieren van successen.
  • Veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw eigen marktgebied.
  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden van je commerciële vaardigheden, vakkennis en groeipotentie.
  • Een goed secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: een goede pensioenregeling, flexibele werktijden en 27 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen.

job.title: Head of Marketing / CMO
job.description:
Humand is an HR tech SaaS platform helping companies build stronger internal cultures through employee engagement, communication, and development tools. We operate in 50+ countries with over 2M active users and recently closed the largest Series A in Latin American history.

We're looking for a Head of Marketing / CMO to lead a 50+ person global marketing team and own the revenue contribution of marketing worldwide.

The core of this role is taking the marketing team to the next level. The next stage is to keep that pace while raising the level of the operation: mature internal processes, a reporting system leadership can trust, clear ownership across areas, and budget decisions grounded in solid data. The goal isn't only to scale faster, it's to scale efficiently.

You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table alongside Sales, Product, and Finance, and own marketing's number in front of the board and investors.

What You'll Own

  • Revenue Accountability & Measurement: own marketing's contribution to pipeline and MRR across LATAM, Brazil, EMEA, and North America, including the multi-touch attribution model, the full-funnel measurement framework, and board and investor reporting.
  • Strategy & Planning: own the global marketing strategy and its translation into regional plans across four regions and 50+ countries, build the projection model connecting investment to output, and own global budget allocation.
  • Organization & Leadership: lead, coach, and develop the marketing org (58 people across 11 sub-areas), design the next layer of the structure, finish maturing the matrix model (global specialists + regional teams), build the OKR and KPI system per vertical, and define levels, salary bands, and career paths.
  • AI-first operator: set the criteria for where AI belongs and where it doesn't, and redesign processes and roles around it. The mandate is to grow output and efficiency without defaulting to more headcount.
  • Cross-functional: partner with the Head of Sales on a joint MKT–Sales roadmap, work with Finance on budget, forecasting, and CAC/LTV discipline, and set the positioning and product marketing strategy together with Product and the CTO.

What We're Looking For

  • Many years in B2B SaaS marketing, leading a marketing org of 40+ people across multiple regions.
  • Experience leading a multi-vertical marketing organization (Growth, Paid Media, Product Marketing, Data & Analytics, Design, Multimedia, Web, Brand & Content).
  • Proven experience operating in HISPAM, Brazil, EMEA, and North America, including leading expansion into at least one of them from outside the region.
  • Proven experience directing the build of a multi-touch attribution model in B2B SaaS.
  • Experience building a financial projection model for marketing and running board and investor reporting for marketing.
  • Experience designing and running a matrix marketing organization and building the people infrastructure of a marketing org.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and develop leaders, including promoting specialists into roles that span disciplines beyond their own.
  • AI-first mindset at the process level, not the tool level. You've restructured workflows, roles, or teams around AI and can show the efficiency it produced.
  • A record of professionalizing a marketing operation.
  • Deep fluency in HubSpot, BI/data warehouse environments, GA4, and the paid media ecosystem (Google, LinkedIn, Meta).
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, plus Spanish and/or Portuguese.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling into APAC.
  • Experience in HR tech, or selling to HR / People / Internal Communications buyers.
  • Experience with PLG or hybrid PLG + sales-led motions.

Why This Role

  • You own marketing end to end for a company at a historic inflection point, with the team, budget, and data infrastructure already in place.
  • A 58-person org that's already built and performing.
  • Direct reporting line to the CEO, a seat at the leadership table, and real ownership of the revenue number.
  • Remote-first, with a global team across LATAM, Brazil, Europe, and North America.

Our mission is to empower people at work, making them happier and more successful. Our purpose: to bring happiness to the world of work.

job.title: Account Executive SMB - LATAM
job.description:
Humand está en busca de un Account Executive para liderar los esfuerzos de ventas en el segmento SMB (pequeñas y medianas empresas) de la región de Latinoamérica (LATAM). Desempeñarás un rol crucial en la generación de ingresos, ofreciendo soluciones de Recursos Humanos ágiles y accesibles para empresas en crecimiento.

Principales Responsabilidades

  • Gestionar y hacer crecer una cartera de clientes SMB en la región LATAM.
  • Desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de ventas de ciclo corto para alcanzar los objetivos de ingresos.
  • Liderar sesiones de descubrimiento con clientes para entender sus desafíos en Recursos Humanos y proponer soluciones.
  • Manejar un alto volumen de oportunidades, priorizando velocidad y eficiencia en cada etapa del pipeline.
  • Colaborar con los equipos de marketing y producto para adaptar las ofertas a los mercados locales de la región.
  • Preparar y presentar demostraciones de productos y propuestas comerciales.
  • Construir relaciones con fundadores, gerentes y líderes de Recursos Humanos para expandir la presencia de Humand en LATAM.
  • Mantener un CRM actualizado con actividades de ventas, seguimiento de pipeline y proyecciones.

¿Qué valoramos?

  • Título universitario en Negocios, Ingeniería Industrial, Marketing o un campo relacionado.
  • Más de 2 años de experiencia en ventas B2B, especialmente en productos de tecnología para Recursos Humanos o SaaS.
  • Experiencia comprobada trabajando con clientes SMB, idealmente con ciclos de venta cortos y alto volumen de cuentas.
  • Sólido entendimiento de los desafíos relacionados con Recursos Humanos y la experiencia del empleado en pequeñas y medianas empresas de la región.
  • Nivel fluido de inglés (deseable portugués para Brasil).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y negociación.

Nuestra misión es empoderar a las personas en el trabajo para hacerlas más felices y exitosas.

Nuestro propósito: llevar felicidad al mundo del trabajo.

job.title: Merchant Partnership Manager
job.description:
Act as the primary point of contact between Got It and key strategic partners, ensuring alignment, collaboration, and long-term relationship success.

Responsibilities

  • Build strong, win-win partnerships with leading brands, driving sustainable value for both sides.
  • Negotiate and finalize partnership agreements that align with Got It’s goals and market positioning.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams (Sales, Finance, CS, Product, Legal) to ensure seamless integration and execution across commercial, operational, and service dimensions.
  • Own the performance of assigned accounts, with strong focus on ROI, disciplined execution, and effective time management.
  • Regularly evaluate partner performance, gather feedback, and coordinate improvements to product features, service quality, and processes.
  • Stay current on market trends, competitor activities, and industry shifts.
  • Proactively share insights and recommendations based on partner feedback and market analysis.

Requirements

  • Minimum 6 years of experience in Sales, Key Account, and Partnership Management. Preference for candidates with hands-on experience in FMCG and managing supermarket/hypermarket channels.
  • Proven experience in project management, merchant acquisition, supplier management, and government relations is a plus.
  • Product mindset with a strong ability to learn quickly and adapt to new solutions.
  • Strong business development skills, excellent at negotiation, and capable of independently driving external partnerships.
  • Ability to understand complex business needs and translate them into actionable solutions.
  • Analytical mindset with a data-driven approach to decision-making.

Why you’ll love working here

  • Opportunities to learn and grow through internal training, rotation, and career advancement.
  • ESOP program – grow together and share in the company’s achievements.
  • Comprehensive healthcare with Bao Viet and full statutory benefits.
  • Full gross salary during probation.
  • Annual salary review based on performance.

job.title: Sales Manager (B2B)
job.location: Ho Chi Minh City / Hanoi, Vietnam
job.description:
I. Company Overview

Dayone is building Vietnam’s leading digital rewards and loyalty ecosystem. Through our platforms - Got It (2015), Scan It (2022), and Buzz It (2024) - we help thousands of businesses reward customers, motivate teams, and drive growth at scale.

Got It is Vietnam’s original and largest digital voucher and gifting platform. Every month we distribute well over 1.5 million vouchers for thousands of clients, powering everything from marketing campaigns and client acquisition to employee rewards and partner incentives.

Scan It focuses on marketing and loyalty. It runs data-driven campaigns that help clients better understand their customers. Brands use Scan It to turn everyday shopping into rewarding experiences, grow their customer base, and run smarter engagement programs.

Buzz It, launched in partnership with Southeast Asia’s leading loyalty platform Buzzebees, is a full end-to-end loyalty solution. We build the front end, design customized programs, integrate systems, and deliver rewards. Under Buzz It sits our Rewards Hub infrastructure - a flexible engine that helps clients seamlessly distribute rewards directly to their customers.

In late 2026 we’re launching Zalo Gift, Vietnam’s first person-to-person social gifting platform. It lets anyone send gifts and treats anytime, directly online — bringing digital gifting into everyday social interactions.

We’re a fast-growing technology company working on products that millions of Vietnamese consumers actually use. We love our products, but our people come first. If you want to ship real products, work at meaningful scale, and join a real team without layers of leadership, come help us perfect what we have and build the next big idea together.

II. What you need to do

  • Own the full B2B sales cycle - from identifying and approaching potential clients to pitching, negotiation, closing, and follow-up.
  • Build and grow your own client pipeline through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and market research.
  • Understand clients’ business needs and pain points, then recommend the right products or solutions to create real business value.
  • Lead sales conversations and product presentations with decision-makers and key stakeholders.
  • Prepare tailored proposals, negotiate commercial terms, and drive deals to closure.
  • Build long-term relationships with clients, turning initial conversations into repeat business and new opportunities.
  • Gather market and customer insights to identify emerging needs, competitive movements, and potential growth opportunities.
  • Track your sales pipeline and performance, using data to prioritize opportunities and improve conversion.
  • Take ownership of quarterly and annual sales targets and continuously look for new ways to grow revenue.

III. What you should have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Have 4+ years of B2B Sales experience, ideally in Digital Solutions, SaaS, Technology, or related industries.
  • Strong business development and hunting mindset, with proven ability to build and manage a sales pipeline.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Strong networking and relationship-building skills with B2B clients and decision-makers.
  • Proactive, resilient, and target-driven, with strong ownership of sales results.

This is a non-manager position; you will work as a Sales Expert and an individual contributor in sales.

Good at English skills is a big plus.

IV. Why you'll love working here

At Got It, we invest in people who grow with us - and foster a culture that values both personal and professional development.

  • Opportunities to learn and grow through internal training, rotation, and career advancement.
  • ESOP program - grow together and share in the company’s achievements.
  • Comprehensive healthcare with Bao Viet and full statutory benefits.
  • Full gross salary during probation.
  • Annual salary review based on performance.

job.title: デジタルギフトプラットフォームを活用したマーケティング・販促支援（フィールドセールス）
job.description:
仕事内容

ギフトパッドは、オリジナルeギフトサービスを核とした独自のプラットフォームを展開し、全国500社以上の企業の販売促進やプロモーションを支援しています。近年では大手銀行と連携し株主優待のDXを推進していくなど、単なるギフトサービスに留まらない独自の地位を確立しています。

IPOを目指し急成長を続ける当社で、多様な業界の企業が抱えるマーケティング・販促、株主優待等の課題に対し、自社プラットフォームを軸とした最適なソリューションを提案します。

商談のフロントに立つフィールドセールスとして、顧客の課題特定から合意形成までを主導し、プロダクト開発部門と連携しながら導入・運用まで一貫して伴走することで、顧客の事業成長を加速させます。

具体的な業務内容

  • 課題の特定とソリューション設計：顧客の経営・事業課題をヒアリングし、マーケティング・販促、株主優待、福利厚生等、用途に応じた最適な解決策を柔軟に構築・提案いたします。
  • 合意形成の推進：意思決定層に対する提案、要件整理、契約締結までの商談プロセスを主導いただきます。
  • 社内巻き込みと運用伴走：商品企画やプロダクト開発部門等の社内チームと連携し、導入から運用支援までを一貫してサポートしていただきます。

スキル・経験

必須要件

  • IT業界 未経験歓迎
  • 法人営業経験2年以上
  • 「なぜ？」を突き詰める思考：言われた通りに動くのではなく、「顧客の真の課題は何か」を自分なりに考え、仮説を立てようとする姿勢を持つ方

歓迎要件

  • 無形商材の営業経験
  • 新規開拓営業の経験
  • 代理店営業の経験

求める人物像

  • 圧倒的な当事者意識：組織や顧客の課題を「自分ごと」として捉え、自ら動ける方
  • 変化を楽しむ柔軟性：急成長中の組織ゆえ、ルールや体制の変化を「面白み」として楽しめる方
  • 素直さと学習意欲：上長との「壁打ち」やAIのフィードバックを素直に取り入れ、自己変革し続けられる方

募集条件

雇用形態：正社員

月給：391,870円～548,363円＋諸手当（基本給：308,000円～431,000円、固定残業代：83,870円～117,363円）

試用期間3ヵ月（給与など条件変更無）。賞与：年2回（6月・12月）。昇給：年2回（社内規定による）。

勤務地：東京都中央区日本橋3丁目2番9号 三晶ビル5階

勤務時間：フレックスタイム制（標準労働時間1日8時間、コアタイム11:00～15:00）

年間休日124日、完全週休2日制（土・日）

job.title: デジタルギフトプラットフォームを活用したマーケティング・販促支援（フィールドセールス）
job.description:
ギフトパッドについて

当社は2011年創業以来、”三方よしの仕組みをつくり「ありがとう」で満ち溢れる社会へ”という理念のもと、企業の経営課題解決、地域活性化に貢献するリレーションプラットフォーム事業を行ってきました。当社が提供するオンラインギフト機能から拡がるプラットフォームは、全国500社以上の企業様において、販売促進・マーケティング・株主優待・福利厚生など様々なシーンでご利用いただいています。

仕事内容

ギフトパッドは、オリジナルeギフトサービスを核とした独自のプラットフォームを展開し、全国500社以上の企業の販売促進やプロモーションを支援しています。商談のフロントに立つフィールドセールスとして、顧客の課題特定から合意形成までを主導し、プロダクト開発部門と連携しながら導入・運用まで一貫して伴走することで、顧客の事業成長を加速させます。

  • 既存顧客への深耕提案：サービス活用中または過去導入済みの顧客に対し、定期的なリレーション構築やアップセル・クロスセル提案を行います。
  • 新規顧客開拓：リード獲得はマーケティング部門からのトスアップがメインです。サービス説明、ヒアリング、企画提案、見積、クロージングまで一貫して担当します。
  • 案件獲得後のサポート：成約後は別部署（カスタマーサクセス部）に引継ぎをしながら、導入から運用が軌道に乗るまで必要に応じてサポートします。
  • 営業戦略立案・CRMツール（Salesforce）を使った顧客管理：上長やチームメンバーと一緒にアカウントごとの営業戦略を立案し、部の予算達成に向けて取り組みます。

必須要件

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
At Giftogram, we believe every thank-you should feel personal — not transactional. Our platform helps businesses appreciate employees, customers, and partners through meaningful, flexible gift cards that create real moments of recognition.

We're the #1 rated rewards and incentives platform on G2, used by more than 22,000 businesses — including 1 in 3 Fortune 500 companies. We're growing, and we're building the team to match.

The Role

As a Strategic Account Manager, you'll own a portfolio of Giftogram's most important customers — mid-market and enterprise organizations who already see Giftogram as a core part of how they recognize and reward people. Your job is to deepen those relationships, uncover expansion opportunities, and make sure every customer feels like they have a real partner in us.

This isn't a cold-start role. You're inheriting real accounts with real momentum. Your job is to grow them.

You'll balance strategy and execution: part trusted advisor, part growth driver, part internal advocate. The best people in this role don't just manage accounts — they make customers want to expand.

What You'll Own

  • A portfolio of active accounts, with full ownership of retention, growth, and satisfaction
  • Upsell and cross-sell opportunities across new teams, departments, and use cases
  • Multi-threaded relationships — you're never relying on a single point of contact
  • Structured business reviews and ROI conversations that connect Giftogram's value to what customers are actually trying to accomplish
  • Accurate pipeline forecasting and account planning in HubSpot
  • A voice for your customers internally — their wins are your wins

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • 3–5+ years in account management, strategic sales, or customer success — with a real track record of expansion, not just renewal
  • Experience working with HR, Finance, or Operations buyers at large organizations — you understand how enterprise decisions get made
  • The ability to build credibility quickly at multiple levels, from daily users to senior stakeholders
  • A consultative approach — you ask good questions, listen well, and bring ideas, not just check-ins
  • CRM discipline (we use HubSpot) and the organizational habits to manage a book without things falling through the cracks

Compensation & Benefits

  • $130,000 – $150,000 OTE with accelerators above target
  • Base salary: $90,000 – $110,000
  • 401(k) with 4% company match
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision — effective Day 1
  • 15 PTO days + paid company holidays

Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you. Strong candidates will be asked to complete a short exercise as part of the process — nothing lengthy, just a chance to show how you think.

job.title: Account Manager, Business Development

Account Manager

Fusion Account Managers are responsible for building and maintaining strong client relationships, understanding client needs, and ensuring exceptional service across Fusion's offerings. Successful team members serve as trusted partners to their clients, proactively identifying opportunities, providing solutions, and collaborating with internal teams to deliver successful programs and experiences. Fusion provides exposure to exciting clients, opportunities for travel, engagement in complex and challenging projects, competitive pay and benefits, and career growth potential in a fast-paced agency environment.

Responsibilities

job.title: Sales Account Executive
job.description:
About Fringe

Fringe is a fast-growing HR technology company based in Virginia. Founded in late 2018, Fringe is the first ever platform for personalized lifestyle benefits. We are a relentlessly people-focused group revolutionizing the way employers care for their people in the benefits space. We're a supportive, down-to-earth team, fully committed to the belief that relationships fuel outstanding client experience.

We built Fringe to give companies a better way to show love and care to their people. Because we believe it's the people who really matter. Companies exist because of the products and services they offer, but we believe the people within them should come first. At Fringe, this is the way we live.

Practically, this means we hire people who care about their teammates just as much as (if not more than) themselves. We hire people who are genuine, humble, willing to learn, ready to teach, able to adapt, flex, collaborate, celebrate each other, win together and lose together.

We're a startup, and that means we must be a courageous group. We solve problems all day, but we also mess up sometimes. We extend grace to each other, and we try again. We aren't looking for perfect people. We're looking for people who own their faults, play to their strengths, and have the courage to simply be the same person all the time.

If that doesn't sound like your cup of cold brew, no hard feelings. But that's exactly who we are and what you can expect when you work at Fringe.

About the Role

Fringe reaches employers two ways: directly, by working with HR leaders who want a better way to care for their people, and through partners like ADP, where Fringe is available to the employers who already trust ADP to run their HR and payroll. Partner-sourced deals move differently. They're warmer, faster, and come with a partner in the room. Direct deals take more discovery, more storytelling, and more hustle. We need someone who's great at both.

You'll be an Account Executive focused on ADP-specific opportunities, alongside a book of our smaller direct deals. You'll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed contract, work closely with our partnership team and ADP's sales teams, and partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to make sure every new client gets off to a great start.

This is a role for a seller who loves variety and wants to help build something. The ADP motion is still growing, which means you'll do more than close deals. You'll help shape the playbook. It's a lot of hats and a rare amount of ownership, visibility, and impact.

Reports to: Senior Director of Growth

What you'll own

ADP partnership deals

  • Run ADP-sourced opportunities end to end: discovery, demo, proposal, and close, often on a much faster timeline than a traditional sales cycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with ADP sales reps and partner teams so Fringe is top of mind when their clients ask about recognition, rewards, and employee experience.
  • Learn the ADP co-sell motion inside and out, and help turn what works into a repeatable playbook.
  • Hand off cleanly to Customer Success so partner-sourced clients launch quickly and see value from day one.

Direct opportunities

  • Own a pipeline of smaller direct deals, typically HR leaders at growing companies who wear a lot of hats.
  • Run sharp, tailored demos that show how Fringe helps a small HR team deliver a best-in-class employee experience without juggling a pile of vendors.
  • Work inbound leads, referrals, and targeted outbound with intention and consistent follow-through.
  • Keep Salesforce clean, your pipeline current, and your forecast honest.

Cross-functional partner

  • Collaborate with Partnerships, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product to win deals together and set clients up for success.
  • Bring back what you're hearing from prospects and partners, and help sharpen our pitch, our process, and our product.

Who you are

  • A natural self-starter. You build your own momentum, manage your own day, and don't need someone looking over your shoulder to hit your number.
  • Versatile. You can run a fast, partner-sourced deal in the morning and a thoughtful direct discovery call in the afternoon, and you enjoy the switch.
  • Open-minded and coachable. You're curious about new ways of selling, welcome feedback, and adapt quickly when something isn't working.
  • A true collaborator. You know the best deals are won together, and you treat partners and teammates like they're on your team, because they are.
  • Someone who owns mistakes, extends grace, and shows up as the same person every day. That's who we are.

Need to haves

  • 3–5 years of B2B sales experience, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Experience owning the full sales cycle, from discovery through close.
  • Comfort managing multiple deals at once, at different speeds and stages.
  • Strong discovery, presentation, and demo skills, with the ability to communicate value to HR leaders and executives.
  • Familiarity with a modern sales tech stack (Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Workspace, Claude, or similar).
  • Self-directed and organized, with the discipline to thrive in a remote role.
  • Quality communicator, written and verbal.

Nice to haves

  • Experience selling HR technology or into HR, benefits, or people teams.
  • SaaS sales experience.
  • Experience working with channel partners, resellers, or co-selling alongside a larger platform. ADP experience is a big plus.

What we offer

Fringe is remote-first, with an office in Richmond, VA for those who want it. Beyond the scope of the role itself, here's what comes with it:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for individuals and families.
  • 3% company match on 401(k) retirement contributions.
  • Unlimited paid time off (2 weeks minimum per year), plus paid holidays, volunteer days, quarterly wellbeing days off, and parental leave.
  • Employee stock options so you can participate in our success.
  • Your choice of monthly Fringe lifestyle benefits on our own marketplace. We use what we build.
  • Free access to DoorDash DashPass & Cloverleaf for personal and team development.
  • Company-sponsored team events, in person and virtually.

job.title: Account Manager — Corporate Cards
job.description:
Fluz is a rewards-first payments company. We build the virtual card and gift card infrastructure that lets people and businesses earn on spending they were already doing, and we let other companies embed that same infrastructure into their own products through our API. We issue virtual cards, run wallets and virtual bank accounts, and move serious volume every month across consumer, corporate and enterprise programs.

We’re a small team that ships fast. We’ve just reorganized into three GM-led business lines, and we’re hiring a General Manager for each.

This role runs Corporate Card. It’s a spend management platform that pays for itself. Businesses control team spend, issue unlimited virtual corporate cards with real controls, pay bills, and earn cash back on everyday expenses, all without leaving the bank they already use. Our cards run on decoupled debit, so they fund straight from an account the customer already has, with no migration, no credit check and no per-user fees. Rewards are actual cash, posted the moment a transaction clears, and on procurement and concentrated merchant spend, the discounts get deep enough to change a company’s cost base rather than just decorate it.

We serve the full range, from early-stage startups issuing their first few cards through to enterprises running serious purchasing volume, on one platform that scales with them, and companies can use it through our app or integrate directly via API. Over 9,000 businesses use it, and we’ve paid out more than $100M in cash back so far.

The role

At Fluz, an account manager is called a Sidekick. You get a named book of corporate spending accounts, you carry a revenue number on it, and you’re expected to grow it.

These are businesses that buy at real volume across procurement, media buying, travel, gifting and inventory. Some arrived as small teams and grew into it; others were already at scale when they signed. Either way, growth here comes from expansion rather than new logos. An account that starts with one department buying gift cards can become five departments running card spend, travel and cardholders across the business. Finding and unlocking that is most of the job.

Part of it is making sure a large order never fails for a preventable reason. When a customer plans a six-figure purchase, funding, limits and timing have to be right in advance. Getting that wrong once costs more trust than a quarter of good service earns back.

You’re also how new things reach the market. We ship constantly: new products, new merchants and deeper rates, new controls, new ways to fund and pay. None of it matters until customers actually use it. When something launches, you’re expected to know it is cold, work out which accounts in your book it’s right for, and go sell it in. Not announce it. Sell it.

What you’ll do

  • Own a named book of corporate accounts and act as their operator, not their ticket queue
  • Monitor spend daily by account and by merchant, and chase declines and dips before the customer notices them
  • Maintain rate agreements: renegotiate as volume changes, handle reconciliations and payouts, and kill rates that are underwater
  • Manage limits, funding capacity and cut-off timing so a large planned order clears the first time
  • Expand accounts: more of the product (procurement through gift cards, bill pay, virtual bank accounts, travel card), more departments, more cardholders, more merchants
  • Take everything we launch to your book: know what’s shipping, work out which accounts it’s right for, and sell it in rather than announce it
  • Handle exceptions with evidence and a recommendation: refunds, capture discrepancies, failed transactions, returns, fee waivers
  • Run quarterly business reviews covering spend, earn delivered, rate performance and what’s coming
  • Bring back what you learn: what landed, what didn’t, and what your customers keep asking for that we don’t have yet
  • Keep account records current on every rate, exception and commitment

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years in B2B account management carrying a revenue number
  • Experience with accounts that spend at scale; you should be comfortable when a single transaction is larger than some people’s quota
  • Detail-level command of the product. When a large order fails, the customer calls you, and you should be able to answer
  • Strong commercial instinct on rate versus margin. You can tell when a customer is costing you money, and you act on it
  • Skill at multi-stakeholder relationships across accounts payable, procurement, finance and operations
  • Numerate and organized. You’ll be reconciling real dollars
  • Someone who goes looking for expansion rather than waiting for the customer to ask

Bonus points

  • You’ve managed corporate card, expense management or corporate gifting programs
  • You’ve handled payment operations issues: chargebacks, returns, settlement timing, funding cut-offs
  • You’ve run QBRs that customers actually found useful

How you’ll be measured

Month-over-month and year-over-year spend growth on your book. Net revenue after rate cost. Logo and dollar retention. Expansion into new merchants, products and departments.

Why this role

Corporate Card is the line with the clearest runway. The product is built, the customers are real businesses with real budgets, and there’s meaningful unclaimed expansion sitting inside the existing base. You’d be early enough to take a lot of it.

job.title: Account Manager — Platform
job.description:
Fluz is a rewards-first payments company. We build the virtual card and gift card infrastructure that lets people and businesses earn on spending they were already doing — and we let other companies embed that same infrastructure into their own products through our API. We issue virtual cards, run wallets and virtual bank accounts, and move serious volume every month across consumer, corporate and enterprise programs.

We’re a small team that ships fast. We’ve just reorganized into three GM-led business lines and we’re hiring across all of them.

This role sits in Platform — our embedded finance business.

Embedded finance means other companies use our technology to put payment features inside their own products, under their own brand. A loyalty app that wants to hand its users a spendable virtual card. An HR platform that needs to send employee rewards. A marketplace paying out sellers. A survey company compensating participants. Rather than build card issuing, wallets, compliance and payout rails themselves — years of work and a banking relationship most companies can’t get — they connect to us and launch in weeks. Their customers see their brand; we’re the infrastructure underneath.

We cover the full range of how money moves: pay-ins (bringing funds in), wallets (holding and governing them), spend (branded virtual cards with merchant and category controls), rewards (gift cards and prepaid delivered instantly), and disbursement (open-loop payouts). Clients use one piece or all five. We’ve processed $5 billion across cards, wallets, pay-ins, payouts and bill payments, and clients integrate through our APIs, drop-in adapters, or low-code widgets. Our developer documentation is public if you want to see what we actually hand to a client.

The role

At Fluz, an account manager is called a Sidekick. On Platform, you own a book of live embedded finance clients — companies running their own card, payout or gift card programs on our infrastructure — and you’re accountable for their volume, their revenue and their renewal.

These clients have engineering teams and their end users feel every problem immediately. When approval rates dip or settlement is late, it’s their customers who notice. You need to catch that before they call you, and you need to be credible when you explain what happened.

You’re also how new things reach the market. We ship constantly — new card types, new wallet and payout capabilities, new funding methods, new ways to integrate — and none of it matters until clients actually put it into production. When something launches, you’re expected to know it is cold, work out which clients it’s right for, and go sell it in. Not announce it. Sell it. With a technical client that means making the case to a product owner and earning a slot on their roadmap, which is a harder sell than a release note and a far more valuable one.

Half the job is commercial: tier progression, true-ups, minimums, expansion, renewal. The other half is operational and technical. Most people are good at one. We’re looking for someone good at both.

What you’ll do

  • Own a named book of live Platform clients as their primary commercial and operational contact
  • Monitor volume, approval rates, decline reasons, chargebacks and settlement daily — investigate deviations before the client raises them
  • Run the operating cadence: regular operational syncs, monthly volume and revenue reviews, quarterly business reviews
  • Manage the commercial relationship: tier progression, true-ups, minimums, renegotiation, invoicing questions, breakage reconciliation
  • Expand accounts across the platform — a client live on payouts may need wallets, spend controls, pay-ins or rewards next, plus new card types, programs and geographies
  • Take new platform capabilities to your clients as they ship: identify who they’re right for, make the case, and get them into production
  • Be the escalation path into our operations, engineering, compliance and banking partners, and own the communication back to the client
  • Keep clients compliant: periodic reviews, refreshed due diligence, and advance notice for program changes that need bank sign-off
  • Feed the product roadmap — what your clients need next, and what it’s worth

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years in technical account management or partner management in payments or embedded finance
  • Commercially sharp and technically credible in the same conversation — you can discuss a rate tier and a webhook failure in the same call
  • Detail-level command of the platform — enough to diagnose a client’s problem before engineering sees it
  • Strong incident and escalation instincts. You know what to communicate, to whom, and how fast
  • Excellent written communication with enterprise clients
  • Comfort reading transaction data and finding the anomaly yourself

Bonus points

  • You’ve supported card issuing, payouts, wallets or gift card programs at an infrastructure provider
  • You’ve worked within a sponsor bank model and know what triggers a bank conversation
  • You’ve owned renewals and expansion, not just health

How you’ll be measured

Month-over-month and year-over-year volume and net revenue by client. Actual volume against contracted volume. Renewal and expansion. Client-reported incident volume and time to resolution.

Why this role

Platform is where the company is placing its biggest bet, and it’s early enough that your accounts will materially move the number. You’ll have direct access to engineering and to the founders, and what you say clients need has a real chance of getting built.

job.title: Operations Coördinator
job.description:
Vacature: Operations Coördinator

Jij houdt overzicht waar anderen dat verliezen. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen vragen, processen en mensen. En je vindt het belangrijk dat dingen niet alleen snel, maar vooral goed geregeld zijn.

Vanwege de groeiende organisatie, zoeken wij versterking op de afdeling Operations. In deze rol ben jij een onmisbare schakel in de dagelijkse operatie. Je maakt direct impact op de ervaring van onze gebruikers en zorgt ervoor dat alles achter de schermen soepel loopt.

Dit ben jij

Je krijgt energie van contact met mensen. Vragen oplossen geeft je voldoening en je houdt ervan om zaken netjes af te ronden. Overzicht bewaren? Dat is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Als Operations Coördinator ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze gebruikers. De ene keer help je bij een vraag over het platform, de andere keer bij een bestelling of formulier. Jij regelt het, legt alles zorgvuldig vast, denkt mee over verbeteringen en schakelt veel met je collega’s.

Je hebt minimaal twee jaar ervaring in een klantenservice- of supportrol en MBO-4 of HBO werk- en denkniveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om een bijdrage te leveren aan een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is. Je werkt binnen een informele organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en collega’s die graag samenwerken.
