  • Salaris min. € 2.625 - max. € 2.750 bruto per maand
  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,23 per km, max. € 150,-)
  • 25% thuiswerken + thuiswerkvergoeding
  • 25 vakantiedagen (met mogelijkheid tot extra onbetaald verlof)
  • Halve vrije dag op je verjaardag
  • Sportvergoeding (€ 100,- per jaar)
  • Fiscaal voordelig producten aanschaffen via FiscFree
  • Gratis fruit op kantoor

job.title: Regional Sales Manager – Corporate Sales
job.description:
FNP is looking for an experienced Regional Sales Manager – Corporate Sales to manage key corporate clients while driving new business opportunities in the Bangalore region. The role will focus on revenue growth, relationship management, business development, and expanding FNP's corporate gifting market presence.

As a key member of the Institutional Sales team, the candidate will work closely with internal teams to deliver customized gifting and engagement solutions for corporate clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Corporate Sales & Revenue Generation: Achieve and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets through direct corporate sales. Close high-value deals with mid-to-large corporate clients across the South region.
  • New Client Acquisition: Identify, prospect, and convert new B2B clients through cold calling, networking, referrals, and industry events. Develop customized gifting and engagement solutions aligned with client requirements and FNP offerings.
  • Key Account Management: Manage relationships with existing corporate clients to drive repeat business and long-term partnerships. Act as the primary point of contact for escalations, new requirements, and account expansion.

job.title: Director, Financial Services Partnerships & Business Development
job.description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

 

 

The Role

Fanatics Financial Services is at the center of Fanatics' ambition to build the world's leading digital sports platform. The Director, Financial Services Partnerships & Business Development will be a senior, externally-facing deal leader responsible for driving high-impact partnerships across financial services and loyalty.   

This individual will own a pipeline of prospective partnerships, leading conversations with senior executives at target companies, structuring deals, and driving them through to launch. They will bring a sharp commercial instinct, deep knowledge of the financial services and loyalty landscapes, and the credibility and hunger to be a primary driver of new partnership value for Fanatics. 

The Director, Financial Services Partnerships & Business Development reports directly to the VP of Enterprise Business Development and works closely with leaders across Loyalty, Commerce, Betting & Gaming, Legal, Finance, and Product. 

 

What You'll Do

  • Partnership Development & Deal Leadership
    • Drive the full business development lifecycle for financial services and loyalty partnerships from prospecting and outreach through term sheet, negotiation, and close
    • Lead partner-facing conversations and presentations, representing Fanatics' value proposition with authority and conviction at the senior executive level
    • Build and manage a robust pipeline of prospective partners across financial services and loyalty, including travel, dining, entertainment, retail, and other categories that create compelling value for Fanatics fans
    • Structure deal economics, partnership frameworks, and value exchange models in collaboration with Finance, Legal, and Product
    • Drive negotiation of key commercial terms and contract provisions, coordinating with Legal and the VP as needed
    • Support partner relationships post-close, ensuring strong ongoing engagement and partnership performance 
  • Strategy & Market Intelligence 
    • Contribute to and help shape Fanatics' financial services and loyalty partnership strategy in collaboration with the VP of Enterprise BD
    • Identify white space opportunities across the financial services and loyalty landscapes where Fanatics' 130M+ user base, sports assets, and platform create differentiated value for partners
    • Develop a loyalty partnership roadmap focused on bringing incremental value to members through experiential benefits, everyday earning opportunities, and exclusive fan-first offers
    • Monitor competitive dynamics, emerging trends in consumer financial services and loyalty, and the broader digital sports ecosystem to inform deal prioritization and positioning 
  • Cross-Functional Execution 
    • Partner with Loyalty, Product, Marketing, and Finance to shape partnership structures that are commercially attractive and operationally executable
    • Develop compelling pitch materials, financial models, and business cases to support partner conversations and secure internal alignment
    • Coordinate with Legal and Compliance on deal structuring, regulatory considerations, and contract execution
    • Serve as a senior point of contact for strategic partners post-close, ensuring strong relationships and partnership performance 

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience
    • 8–12 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or management consulting, with meaningful exposure to financial services, loyalty, or consumer platforms
    • Demonstrated track record of leading and closing complex, high-value partnerships, including managing partner relationships and negotiations at the senior executive level
    • Strong understanding of the consumer financial services landscape and how partnerships can create value for both companies and end customers
    • Experience with loyalty program partnerships including an understanding of earn/burn mechanics, member value proposition design, and coalition-style or co-brand partnerships
    • Prior experience in a sports, entertainment, e-commerce, or consumer platform environment is a plus 
  • Skills & Attributes
    • A natural deal leader that is comfortable owning partner conversations end-to-end and driving towards close with urgency and commercial discipline
    • Strong financial and analytical acumen; ability to build and communicate ROI-driven business cases with clarity
    • Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Capable of distilling complex deal structures into crisp, compelling narratives for both partners and internal stakeholders
    • Highly organized and execution-oriented; able to manage multiple complex deal processes simultaneously in a fast-moving environment
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action; comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at driving alignment across decentralized organizations
    • Collaborative and humble, with the interpersonal credibility to build trust across functions and levels
    • A genuine passion for sports and belief in Fanatics' mission to relentlessly enhance the fan experience

Why This Role Matters 

Financial services and loyalty partnerships are two of the highest-leverage growth vectors for Fanatics. This Director will be one of the primary drivers of new strategic partnerships on the team, operating with the autonomy and ambition of a senior deal leader and backed by the brand power of a category-defining sports platform, as well as relationships with 130M+ fans, leagues, teams, and athletes. The partnerships you close will directly shape the fan experience and the future of Fanatics 

 

 

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$215,000—$230,000 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

job.title: Director, Gift Card Program Management & Marketing
job.description:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

 

The Team:

Fanatics Gift Card Business sells over 200 different gift cards through tens of thousands of ecomm and physical stores in more than 10 countries, serving our clients’ fandom aspirations around gifting, self-rewarding, and business needs — and materially scaling it is a strategic priority for the company. The Global Gift Card Team operates as a high-velocity, entrepreneurial unit inside Fanatics, with the agility of a FinTech startup backed by the infrastructure of a global sports platform powerhouse: a highly collaborative, cross-functional team transforming, shaping, and scaling the business into a high-growth global acquisition engine, grounded in proactive ownership, creative problem-solving, and a shared passion for connecting sports fans worldwide to the brands they love.

The Role:

Fanatics is seeking a Head of Gift Card Program Management & Marketing to lead the day-to-day operational team, serving as the beating heart of the business, drive the team’s approach and execution across all special tech/ops/modernization projects, and scale the company’s gift card program across marketing, external existing partnerships with a focus on 3P, and internal business channels. This is a highly cross-functional role responsible for driving omnichannel marketing strategy, managing key distribution and financial partnerships, and overseeing day-to-day program operations — both domestically and internationally. The ideal candidate is a strategic operator who thrives at the intersection of program management, marketing with a focus of performance marketing, business operations, and business development, and is excited to build and lead a growing team. This role will manage a team of two full-time employees and two contractors, with the expectation of continued growth alongside the business.

What You’ll Do:

Internal Business Development & Program Operations

  • Oversee end-to-end team and program and management, including design and creative workflows, timeline management, and operational execution to keep the program running efficiently
  • Lead internal account management across B2B, B&M, and Events channels, ensuring alignment with broader program goals and maximizing cross-sell opportunities
  • Manage all domestic and international program operations, with responsibility for supporting continued growth in both areas
  • Lead the respective day-today program interface around all tech and ops modernization for the gift card business
  • Build, develop, and lead a growing team of direct employees and contractors, fostering a high-performance, collaborative culture

External Account Management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for all day-to-day external distribution and operational partners, spanning gift card processing networks, third-party vendors, retail distribution platforms and printing vendors
  • Manage the full lifecycle of external distribution and operational partner relationships, including day-to-day account management, performance reviews, issue resolution, and cross-sell initiatives, with a focus on opportunities development directly with the distribution partners
  • Identify and pursue new external partnership opportunities to expand gift card distribution reach and drive incremental revenue

Marketing Leadership

  • Lead omnichannel marketing execution across all channels, including third-party platforms, first-party channels, social media, paid social, paid search, B2B, athlete relations, influencer marketing, affiliate programs, and sponsorships, with a focus on performance marketing
  • Own the annual marketing strategy and planning process, including budget allocation, campaign execution, performance tracking, and reporting across all channels
  • Develop and manage relationships with media partners, agencies, and platform vendors to optimize channel performance and return on investment

What We’re Looking For:

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in gift card, including technical advanced knowledge operations, set-ups, architecture, data & reporting, with at least 3 years in a leadership capacity
  • Demonstrated experience leading integrated, omnichannel marketing campaigns across paid, owned, and earned channels, with material understanding in performance marketing
  • Deep understanding and connections across the gift card ecosystem, including third-party retail and digital distribution, corporate B2B programs, processors and printers
  • Proven track record managing strategic external partnerships with financial institutions, retail distributors, or digital platforms, and delivering on cross-selling and bizdev opportunities with such partners
  • Strong people manager with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously including design and creative workflows
  • Strong analytical capabilities; comfortable with performance tracking, reporting, and budget management across multiple channels
  • Ownership mindset, strong work ethic, and natural curiosity to proactively identify and pursue opportunities beyond what is explicitly requested
  • Collaborative, relationship-driven leader who thrives in ambiguity, manages competing priorities effectively, and balances strategic thinking with hands-on execution
  • Passion for the sports fandom space
  • Ability to work in the NYC office 4 days per week
  • Managing internal business channels such as B2B, B&M, and event-based programs preferred
  • Experience supporting or leading international programs is a plus

The salary range represents base pay only and does not include short-term or long-term incentive compensation. When determining base pay as part of a final compensation package, we consider several factors such as location, experience, qualifications, and training. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

$180,000—$250,000 USD

job.title: Manager, Loyalty Consulting
job.description:
LOYALTY IS BOOMING. COME BUILD IT WITH US.

Melbourne ideal. Sydney option. Hybrid. Full-time.

You’ve built your consulting craft at a Big Four firm or established management consultancy: the frameworks, the client rigour, the quality of strategic advice. Now you’re ready to step up, lead engagements, work directly with decision-makers and build deep specialist expertise in a high-growth category.

Ellipsis are The Loyalty Experts®, a specialist consultancy on a mission to become the best loyalty business in the world. We’re growing, and we’re adding a Manager to lead client engagements alongside our Founders and Partners. This is a senior, hands-on consulting role. You’ll lead engagements end-to-end and stay close to the work, shaping the thinking, building the models and presenting to client executives. Your focus is on clients and craft rather than line management.

You don’t need to know loyalty yet. You need to be exceptional at consulting. Loyalty is one of the fastest-growing categories in customer strategy. The Australian market alone is worth over $6 billion and growing at 13% a year. We’ll back you to build genuine specialist depth, learning from people who’ve spent their careers in it.

What's in it for you

  • Proximity to leadership with little hierarchy. Direct access to our Founders, Partners and senior leadership.
  • Senior client exposure. You’ll be the day-to-day lead for blue-chip brands across retail, banking, insurance and travel.
  • Real ownership. You’ll lead and deliver engagements end-to-end, and contribute to proposals and pitches.
  • A growth category. Loyalty is booming and short on senior talent. Get in now and become one of the deepest specialists in the market.
  • Thought leadership on tap. Learn from Founders who are shaping the category from the Australian Loyalty Association's Loyalty Economics masterclass to a growing library of enviable proprietary IP.
  • Flexible hybrid working, an above-market annual leave entitlement, and personal technology and professional development budgets.
  • Based in The Commons, Melbourne and Sydney giving perks of networking, cool spaces, free breakfast, events, lunches and drinks, ability to work across multiple sites.

What you'll do

  • Lead complex client engagements end-to-end, from scoping and problem definition through to final recommendations, while personally owning core workstreams and deliverables.
  • Shape the problem-solving approach for each engagement by setting hypotheses, structuring the work and guiding the analysis to clear, fact-based recommendations.
  • Act as the senior day-to-day contact for clients, leading workshops, steering committees and executive presentations.
  • Build and review financial models and business cases that quantify the commercial value of loyalty programme design, partnerships and initiatives.
  • Quality-assure deliverables to Ellipsis standards, using data visualisation and storytelling to bring recommendations to life.
  • Scope engagements and manage them to time, scope and budget, raising risks early with proposed solutions.
  • Contribute to proposals and pitches, and grow existing client relationships through follow-on work.
  • Support and coach colleagues on your engagements, and contribute to Ellipsis IP and thought leadership.

Who you are

  • 4+ years’ experience, including a strong grounding in a Big Four or established management consulting firm.
  • A track record of leading workstreams or engagements and managing client stakeholders directly.
  • Strong financial modelling and business case skills, with advanced data analysis and visualisation.
  • Fluent in structured problem-solving (First Principles, Hypothesis-Based Problem Solving, Pyramid Principle).
  • Experience contributing to proposals.
  • Proficient in AI productivity tools and Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
  • Commercially minded, proactive and precise, with the executive presence to challenge and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Customer experience or loyalty experience is a bonus, but not essential.

How to apply

Send your CV and two or three lines on an engagement you led and the outcome it delivered to: julie.dormand@ellipsisandco.com

You must have full Australian working rights (citizen or permanent resident). We’re unable to offer visa sponsorship. We review every application.

新製品・関連ソリューションのクロスセルを推進。マーケティングと連携し導入事例の創出やユーザーミーテ ィングを企画。 関係部署（マーケ、加盟店営業、CSM、プロダクト、カスタマーサポート）と連携し、新製品への円滑な移行 をリード。

電話・メール・オンライン会議等を通じた高い活動量を継続し、グループ定義の KPI（インプット：活動量／ アウトプット：契約数）に基づき、正確かつタイムリーに報告。

・質問力・交渉力

歓迎

求める人物像

Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

組織に関して： ⚫ 「チケットレストラン®」加盟店に関する専任部門として、加盟店営業本部は2026年に組織編制され ました。そのため、現在は組織を構築拡大するフェーズにあります。 目下、加盟店営業本部のメンバー構成は、部門を統括する本部長と、加盟店営業担当が1名の計2名で す。今後メンバーを増員して組織を強固にするため、積極的に採用を強化しています。 ⚫ 加盟店営業本部長は、直接 日本オフィスの代表取締役 CEO にレポートをしています。また、他の部門 とのコミュニケーションも活発に行われており、非常にフラットで風通しの良い組織体制です 募集ポジションについて：

  • エデンレッドグループでは、今後飛躍的にビジネスを延伸していくために、「チケットレストラン®」取扱 加盟店のさらなる拡大を計画しており、「加盟店営業担当」として活躍いただける人材を募集しています。 加盟店営業は、主に以下の2つの役割を担っていただきます。
  • 新規加盟店獲得 大手の外食チェーンやスーパーマーケットなどのテイクアウト販売を行う流通企業などの大手法人か ら、中小の個人レストランまで、様々な事業規模のターゲットクライアントとのコミュニケーションを 通じて、「チケットレストラン®」への理解と関心を得ながら、加盟店契約を獲得します。 また、代理店を通じた営業委託推進に対して、委託先の営業活動の管理や支援も行います。 契約加盟店との関係向上 加盟店契約獲得後は、「チケットレストラン®」をより多くの加盟店従業員のみなさまに深くご理解い ただけるよう、コミュニケーションを通じた関係向上を図ります。 特に、加盟店視点での「チケットレストラン®」利用実績や動向を数値で分析のうえ、加盟店と状況を 共有し、ネクストアクションを検討、協議していただくことが重要になります。 また、協議を通じて、店頭の「チケットレストラン®」ロゴの表示環境を整えたり、エデンレッドアプ リなどを活用したプロモーション施策を企画から提案、実行までを展開したりするなど、加盟店におけ る「チケットレストラン®」の利用者数、取扱高の向上に向けて、チームメンバーと共に活動します

「加盟店営業担当」は、顧客企業においての課題・改善点の洗い出す「ヒアリング力・質問力」、提案を実 際に顧客組織内でアクションとして実行させていく顧客に対する「ドライブ力・実行能力」とともに、高い 活動量（電話・メール等でのコミュニケーション）を継続的に維持することができる能力が重要になるポジ ションです。

これらの能力を発揮するためには、仕事に対するコミットメント力と、自ら考えて能動的に行動する自走力 が必要と考えています。従来の型にはまった営業手法を単純に横展開するだけではなく、失敗を恐れずに新 しい施策を積極的に試して、更なる結果や気付きを追い求めることが出来る方を求めています。

組織に関して：

  • 「チケットレストラン®」加盟店に関する専任部門として、加盟店営業本部は2026年に組織編制され ました。そのため、現在は組織を構築拡大するフェーズにあります。 目下、加盟店営業本部のメンバー構成は、部門を統括する本部長と、加盟店営業担当が1名の計2名で す。今後メンバーを増員して組織を強固にするため、積極的に採用を強化しています。
  • 加盟店営業本部長は、直接 日本オフィスの代表取締役 CEO にレポートをしています。また、他の部門 とのコミュニケーションも活発に行われており、非常にフラットで風通しの良い組織体制です

直近1年間でお任せしたい業務：

  • 加盟店営業本部の他のメンバーと共に、前述の役割を担っていただき、新規加盟店の獲得と、契約加盟 店との関係強化を通じて、「チケットレストラン®」加盟店の利用者、取扱高の増大に貢献いただきま す。 新規加盟店獲得は、提携するパートナー企業や金融機関等とのネットワークを広げることで、「チケ ットレストラン®」にふさわしい外食産業関連企業を紹介いただき、エデンレッドとパートナー企業 で協力して獲得していきます。 また、契約加盟店との関係向上では、加盟店営業本部のメンバーと共に、データを分析の上、加盟店 への報告を通じて、より「チケットレストラン®」が利用されやすい店頭環境づくりをお願いいたし ます。
  • 全ての活動はCRM（Salesforce）に入力していただきます。また、社内で策定されたKPI（加盟店獲得 数、加盟店取扱高、等）に基づいて、加盟店営業本部長と共にタイムリーに進捗状況をトラックしま す。また週に複数回開催されるレビュー会議で予算達成に向けたアクションプランを報告いただきま す。

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
VIBE WITH US

Seek a highly motivated and goal-oriented Business Development Manager drive growth by identifying, developing, and securing business opportunities with enterprise and mid-market clients. This role requires a strong background in revenue delivery, sales planning, and relationship management. You will play a critical role in acquiring new customers and ensuring adoption.

  • Develop and execute outreach plans to target high-value decision-makers.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the white space segment, Indian companies and multinationals
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with CXO-level executives and key stakeholders.
  • Lead the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting, needs assessment, proposal development, negotiation, and closing.
  • Report on KPIs and sales forecasts using CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot). Expectation is to deliver 4X business pipeline and revenue quota month-on-month.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, product, and customer success teams to align offerings with market needs.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies.

VIBE WITH YOU

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Business Marketing, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in similar industry, enterprise sales or B2B2C sales
  • Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in complex, B2B sales environments.
  • Strong knowledge about Loyalty Marketing, rewards management, promotions, B2B Corporate Sales and/or Employee Engagement
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and presentation skills
  • Able to work independently with minimum supervision and achieve stretch targets

Preferred Skills

  • Ability to identify, segment and scale customer acquisition efforts
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage CXO or senior level relationships

Außerdem erhältst du 15 x 7,67 EUR Ticket Restaurant Schecks, die du in vielen Supermärkten, Cafés, Restaurants und Bäckereien deutschlandweit flexibel nutzen kannst.

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
At Edenred, we believe that healthy and engaged employees are the foundation of a thriving organization. Every day, we provide innovative solutions to improve the lives of millions of Belgians by connecting 1.8 million employees, 70,000 companies, and tens of thousands of merchants and partners.


But it is as a team that we continue to improve the workplace and imagine the world of tomorrow. What if you were part of it?


At Edenred, we recognize, recruit, and develop all talents while respecting each individual's uniqueness.

We encourage and consider all applications without distinction of origin, gender, identity or expression of gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other protected criteria as defined by Unia.

WE WILL VIBE WITH YOU

We are looking for an Account Manager dedicated to partnerships as part of our Sales Team.


As an Account Manager, you will manage and develop our network of indirect partners. As the true orchestrator of the partner ecosystem, you will be responsible for revenue growth through our indirect channels and the development of new strategic opportunities. 


More specifically, you will be responsible for:


Management and development of the partner portfolio

  • Manage and optimize an existing portfolio of indirect partners
  • Develop sustainable strategic relationships with key partners
  • Identify and recruit new partners to expand our distribution network.
  • Design and implement commercial action plans tailored to each type of partner.

Commercial performance and review

  • Define and monitor sales objectives per channel and per partner
  • Review commercial performance data and identify growth drivers
  • Interpret market trends and project sales results
  • Produce regular reports and strategic presentations for management

Network animation and training

  • Train partners on our solutions, products and services
  • Organize partner events (webinars, workshops, conventions)
  • Provide continuous commercial support and field assistance
  • Develop tools and materials to facilitate indirect sales

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing teams to develop partner campaigns
  • Coordinate with Communiction to create adapted content and materials.
  • Collaborate with IT to optimize partner tools and processes
  • Participate in cross-functional commercial development projects



WE WILL VIBE WITH YOU


  • You have proven experience of minimum 5 years in managing and developing a network of indirect partners, ideally in a B2B2C environment.
  • You are bilingual Dutch and French
  • You feel comfortable with digital tools, including Microsoft and CRM (Salesforce is a plus). You have a strong interest and ideally already used Artificial Intelligence in a professional context (data analysis, automation or commercial optimization,…).
  • You possess strong analytical skills, particularly within commercial environments, with a proven ability to interpret complex performance metrics, develop reliable forecasts, and synthesize data-driven insights into actionable strategic recommendations.

Personal qualities:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to federate a partner network
  • Autonomy, proactivity and entrepreneurial spirit
  • Results-oriented with business acumen
  • Ability to work in project mode with cross-functional teams
  • Excellent communicator, comfortable in presentations

At Edenred, we recognize, recruit, and develop all talents while respecting each individual's uniqueness.

We encourage and consider all applications without distinction of origin, gender, identity or expression of gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other protected criteria as defined by Unia.



START DATE

ASAP



OTHER INFORMATION

  • Permanent full-time contract (38 hours/week).
  • Location: Brussels (Auderghem). National mobility for regular travel to partners is necessary for this role.
  • A stimulating position within a dynamic organization that focuses on technological innovation to enhance workers' purchasing power.
  • The opportunity to work remotely 2 days a week with your manager's approval, including a homeworking allowance of 115€.
  • You are covered with hospitalization and ambulatory care insurance (with the option to extend it to your family).
  • You benefit from all Edenred-solutions, such as vouchers but also Edenred Engagement (including Edenred Discounts).
  • Your package includes a car.

Enrich connections. For good

job.title: 【フィールドセールス】予防医療・健康インフラ領域｜企業・健保の課題を解決するソリューション営業｜M3グループ
job.description:
募集背景

健康保険組合や企業を取り巻く健康管理業務の課題は、年々高度化しています。健診運営の事務負荷軽減だけでなく、受診率向上、加入者特性に応じた施策設計、健康データ活用など、求められる支援の幅は広がっています。当社では、健康診断事務代行サービスを中心に、健保設立・運営支援、データヘルス計画策定支援など、多様なヘルスケアソリューションを展開しています。今後さらなる市場開拓を進めるため、新規顧客開拓を担う営業メンバーを募集します。

このポジションで求めているのは、既存の関係性に頼る営業ではなく、自ら市場を切り拓き、数字で成果を出せる人材です。

お任せしたいこと

健康保険組合や企業が抱える健康管理業務・健診運営上の課題に対して、健康診断事務代行サービスをはじめとする各種ヘルスケアソリューションを提案します。新規顧客との接点創出から商談、提案、クロージングまでを担う“攻め”の営業です。

  • 新規開拓に向けたアプローチ戦略の立案
  • セミナー参加団体、資料請求先へのフォローアップ
  • 既存顧客からの紹介案件への営業対応
  • 健保や企業が抱える健康管理業務・健診運営課題のヒアリング
  • 健康診断事務代行サービスを活用した提案活動
  • 健保設立・運営支援、データ活用コンサルティング等を含むソリューション提案
  • 提案資料作成、プレゼンテーション
  • 競合サービスからのリプレイス提案、コンペ案件対応
  • システム部門・運用部門と連携した提案設計
  • 受注後の運用部門への引き継ぎ
  • 案件に応じた導入プロジェクトの推進

必須スキル・経験

  • 新規開拓営業の経験、または新規案件獲得に強みをお持ちの方
  • 目標達成に向けて継続的に行動し、成果を出してきた経験をお持ちの方
  • 業界未経験歓迎。法人・個人向け、業界は問いません

歓迎スキル・経験

  • 有形商材の法人営業経験
  • 健保、医療、ヘルスケア領域に関する営業経験
  • BPOサービスの営業経験
  • リプレイス提案、コンペ案件対応経験
  • 提案資料作成、プレゼンテーション経験
  • 複数部署を巻き込みながら案件を推進した経験

求める人物像

  • 新規開拓営業が好きな方
  • 目標数字を追い、達成することにやりがいを感じる方
  • 自ら機会をつくりにいく営業スタイルを好む方
  • 受け身ではなく、自分で考えて動ける方
  • 負けず嫌いで、結果にこだわれる方
  • 顧客課題を捉えながらも、最終的には受注に持ち込む推進力がある方

待遇・条件

  • 予定年収：500~800万円
  • 月給：基本給（343,260円～）+インセンティブ（ご経験・スキルを考慮の上決定）
  • 昇給：年1回／賞与：年2回
  • 勤務時間：9:00～18:00（所定8時間、休憩60分）、フレックスタイム制（コアタイム 11:00～14:00）
  • 年間休日121日以上、土日祝祭日
  • 社会保険完備、交通費全額支給、WELBOX、カフェテリアプラン（年間最大15万円分のポイント）、資格取得お祝い金制度、自己啓発費補助、退職金制度（企業型確定拠出年金制度）

勤務地：東京都。総合職での雇い入れとなります。当面は予定していませんがキャリア形成に伴い転勤の可能性はあります。

job.title: 福利厚生サービスの企画営業
job.description:
業務内容

福利厚生パッケージサービス（WELBOX）のサービスメニューの企画・開発・提携などを担当していただきます。会員満足度向上と提携先企業の集客・売上拡大の両方を実現するため、データ分析から企画立案、提案、運用まで一貫して携わることができます。

業務詳細

  • 既存提携先との関係構築、契約更新
  • 利用実績データの分析
  • 利用促進施策やキャンペーンの企画、提案
  • 新たな提携先の開拓

提携先とのやり取りは基本的にメールや電話が中心です。「どうすれば利用者がもっと使いたくなるか」「どうすれば提携先の集客に貢献できるか」を考えながら企画を形にしていく仕事です。

WELBOXとは

WELBOXは、企業で働く従業員やそのご家族の暮らしを豊かにする福利厚生サービスです。宿泊施設やレジャー施設、グルメ、ショッピング、育児・介護支援、自己啓発など、幅広いサービスを優待価格で利用できるプラットフォームを提供しています。

ポジションの魅力

会員の利用動向やニーズをもとに、キャンペーンやサービスを企画します。企画した施策の成果が利用実績として見えるため、自身の提案がサービス成長につながる実感を得られます。

配属先

HRソリューション本部 WELBOX企画部 ステイグループ。入社後は宿泊・旅行領域を中心に担当いただきます。

就業環境

  • 残業時間は月10～20時間程度です。
  • 在宅勤務、フレックス制度が利用できます。
  • 20代～50代の幅広い年齢層の社員が就業されており、明るく活気のある雰囲気です。

必須スキル・経験

  • 営業経験（目安2年以上）

歓迎スキル・経験

  • 旅行業界での業務経験（販促、商品、サービス企画／通販やwebでの企画／仕入れ担当、営業等）
  • 集客メディアでの提案営業経験
  • 集客施策や販促企画の立案・実行経験
  • ECコンサルタント経験

求める人物像

  • 自発的にコミュニケーションが取れる方
  • 課題解決のため主体的に改善提案ができる方
  • 数千名の従業員に対して影響のあるサービスを取り扱うことに関心のある方

待遇

  • 予定年収：400万円～570万円
  • 月給：基本給（238,200円～）
  • 昇給：年1回／賞与：年2回
  • 社会保険完備、交通費全額支給
  • カフェテリアプラン（年間最大15万円分のポイント付与）
  • 年間休日121日以上、土日祝祭日
  • 退職金制度（企業型確定拠出年金制度）

job.title: Payment Operations Project Manager
job.description:
EML Payments is a global leader in the fintech space. Our mission is to create awesome, instant, and secure payment solutions that connect our customers to their customers, anytime, anywhere, wherever money is in motion. Our Purpose is to inspire transformative digital change for our customers and communities.

As an issuer and processor, we provide our clients and partners with innovative alternatives to traditional banking solutions for reloadable and non-reloadable programs. We are agile, we are innovative. We take a partnership approach; we tailor solutions and place a strong focus on operational excellence.

The team you'll be joining

Our Payment Operations & Change team plays a key role in EML's transformation journey, modernising processes, driving automation, and creating a best-in-class operation. The team manages projects and operational initiatives while overseeing critical relationships with payment networks, card schemes (Visa, Mastercard), acquirers, processors, card bureaus, and associated service providers across Australia and globally.

We work closely with teams across the business, including our Scheme Management function, to deliver operational excellence and drive cost efficiency. Our collaborative approach ensures we are ready to meet evolving customer and regulatory needs in Australia and globally.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Project Manager who thrives on delivery and takes pride in seeing initiatives through to completion. This role is critical to EML's global Operations team, delivering card scheme and tokenisation projects, payment operations transformation and cross-functional initiatives.

You will have subject matter knowledge of the Payments industry, be detail-oriented and have a track record of delivery. Success in this role means combining structured project management, including clear planning, risk management, governance, and clear accountability, with the agility to roll up your sleeves and drive actions forward.

You will be a safe pair of hands in the Payment Operations team, supporting both large and small initiatives. From individual client delivery projects, and associated reporting, to improving our card scheme project delivery for efficiency and scale.

This role demands exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills. You will provide clarity and confidence through concise, accurate reporting and updates.

What you'll do

  • Manage a portfolio of complex initiatives that span one or multiple lines of business, with a focus on payments and card projects.
  • Own full project lifecycle delivery, from initiation through to deployment and BAU handover, for one or more initiatives simultaneously.
  • Lead delivery of card scheme mandate changes (Visa and Mastercard) and BIN/program implementations, partnering with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive delivery of compliance-related initiatives (e.g., data integrity program, regulatory requirements) to ensure obligations are met on time.
  • Report on project success criteria results, metrics, testing, and deployment management activities.
  • Provide a delivery focus within the Payment Operations team, coordinating and driving completion of process improvements and transformation initiatives.
  • Work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment demonstrating teamwork, innovation, and excellence.
  • Prepare appropriate trackers or detailed project plans covering all phases of your projects.
  • Procure and manage adequate resources to achieve project objectives in planned timeframes.
  • Manage the day-to-day project activities and resources, and provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and issues.
  • Understand interdependencies between technology, operations, compliance, and business needs.
  • Manage ongoing quality control and participate in quality issue resolution.
  • Delegate tasks and responsibilities to appropriate personnel, and effectively communicate with senior stakeholders, team members, clients, and other stakeholders.
  • Continue professional development to keep abreast of emerging technologies, methods, and best practices in payments and project delivery.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in appropriate field of study or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of project management experience within the Payments industry, including tracking and planning projects.
  • Experience delivering projects in payments, card issuing or financial services (e.g. scheme mandate rollouts, BIN/Program implementations, compliance remediation) is highly regarded.
  • Familiarity with the Australian payments landscape (AP+, AusPaynet, AUSTRAC, ePayment Code, RBA frameworks) is advantageous.
  • Intermediate level of proficiency with MS Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint, with experience presenting to stakeholders and/or Senior Leadership.
  • Interpersonal skills to influence and spur change, facilitate, and enhance performance within a cross-functional environment.
  • Demonstrate decisiveness in resolving business problems, making decisions, and identifying priorities.
  • Experience negotiating vendor contracts.
  • Experience drafting and submitting budget proposals and recommending subsequent budget changes where necessary.
  • Experience in successfully leading projects and programs on time and on schedule and within budget parameters.
  • Experience leading, motivating, and managing various project and program team sizes, including internal and external resources, while holding team accountable for performance.
  • Experience influencing and gaining buy-in from executives, sponsors, team members, stakeholders, and peers.

Behavioural & Communication

  • Bias for Action: You unblock, decide, and deliver.
  • Governance Balance: Apply minimum effective process for speed and control.
  • Excellent Communication & Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage at all levels, summarise complex information clearly, and influence decisions effectively.
  • Decisiveness: Demonstrate sound judgement in resolving business problems, making decisions, and identifying priorities.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager
job.description:
We are looking for a commercially focused Strategic Account Manager to own a portfolio of key Australian customers. You will be the primary commercial relationship owner, accountable for customer retention, portfolio performance, strategic growth, renewals and senior stakeholder engagement.

You will develop a clear view of each customer's business, priorities, risks and growth potential. You will turn that understanding into practical account plans, executive engagement, qualified opportunities and coordinated action across EML.

This role suits someone who combines sound commercial judgement with disciplined execution. You will bring recommendations, not only issues, and lead customer outcomes across EML without taking ownership away from specialist operational and technical teams.

What you will do

  • Own the relationship for a portfolio of strategic customers, accountable for retention, revenue and long-term growth
  • Build and deliver account plans that set clear priorities, map key stakeholders and anticipate renewals
  • Spot risks early and coordinate the right support across EML before they become renewal issues
  • Develop trusted relationships from operational contacts to executive decision-makers, positioning EML as a strategic partner
  • Grow existing accounts by identifying and converting upsell, cross-sell and product adoption opportunities
  • Lead renewals, pricing discussions and commercial negotiations, protecting both the relationship and margin
  • Run QBRs and executive reviews that end in clear decisions and next steps
  • Track portfolio performance (revenue, margin, usage and pipeline) and keep CRM and reporting accurate
  • Be the voice of the customer across Product, Operations, Finance, Risk and Compliance, and own the commercial side of escalations
  • Contribute to team initiatives that improve how we work and engage customers

What you will bring

  • Experience in strategic or key account management, customer success or a similar B2B commercial role
  • Experience in payments, fintech, card issuing or another regulated environment
  • A track record of retaining and growing complex, high-profile customers, including renewals and commercial negotiations
  • Strong commercial judgement: you weigh revenue, margin, risk and delivery capacity to recommend the right course of action
  • Confidence building trusted relationships and influencing stakeholders up to executive level, both with customers and internally
  • An analytical approach, using revenue, usage and pipeline data to spot trends, risks and opportunities
  • Clear, concise communication, from account updates to executive briefs
  • A collaborative, ownership mindset, working across Product, Operations, Finance, Risk and Compliance to deliver outcomes
  • Adaptability in a fast-moving payments and regulatory environment

What we offer

  • Flexible, fast-paced dynamic working environment
  • Global business landscape that connects you with colleagues working throughout Europe, USA and Australia
  • Participation in the company bonus scheme
  • Flexible working - Be empowered to work smarter, in a way that suits your lifestyle
  • 12w Parental Leave, Birthday Leave, Volunteer leave & Paid Professional memberships.
  • Additional week of annual leave when you take you leave allocation each year

job.title: Junior Marketeer Loyalty Marketing
job.description:
Wil jij werken aan creatieve marketingprojecten die écht impact maken? Krijg je energie van spraakmakende loyaliteitsprogramma’s voor A-merken en diverse doelgroepen?

Bij ons in Utrecht krijg je de kans om je talenten te ontwikkelen, ervaring op te doen en te groeien als marketingprofessional binnen een enthousiast en toonaangevend team.

Jouw rol als Junior Marketeer

Als Junior Marketeer maak je deel uit van ons Loyalty Management team en draag je bij aan het succes van meerdere marketingprojecten. Je ondersteunt bij de implementatie en het beheer van loyalty marketingprojecten zoals joint promotions, voordeelprogramma’s, spaaracties en inspirerende communicatiecampagnes binnen de customer journey.

Je dagelijkse werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:

  • Creatieve loyalty marketingconcepten bedenken en uitwerken.
  • Joint promotions voor loyaliteitsprogramma’s organiseren.
  • Content en communicatie ontwikkelen en optimaliseren voor o.a. web, app, e-mail en magazines.
  • Planningen beheren en afstemmen met interne en externe stakeholders.
  • Campagnes en programma’s inrichten in onze (online) marketing systemen.
  • Marketingactiviteiten rapporteren, evalueren en optimaliseren.
  • Bijdragen aan de marketing van Dunck zelf.

Wat breng jij mee?

Wij zoeken een enthousiaste en leergierige marketeer die graag initiatief neemt. Dit vragen wij van jou:

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in marketing, communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Tot 3 jaar werkervaring.
  • Nauwkeurigheid en sterke projectmanagementvaardigheden.
  • Klantgerichtheid, creativiteit en een ondernemende houding.
  • Uitstekende sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.
  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij Dunck krijg je de kans om te groeien in een stimulerende en inspirerende omgeving. Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en ontwikkeling. Dunck bestaat uit een team van gedreven marketingprofessionals. We zijn trots op wat we doen, groeien hard en hebben veel plezier in ons werk.

  • Impactvolle functie: een flexibele en zelfstandige functie met duidelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
  • Inspirerende werkomgeving: samenwerken met een team van gedreven en enthousiaste professionals.
  • Aantrekkelijk salaris: een marktconform salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.
  • Dynamische en collegiale cultuur: een informele, professionele werksfeer met ruimte voor plezier en samenwerking.

job.title: Productieplanner m/v
job.description:
Over de functie van Productieplanner m/v

Productieplanner is een uitdagende baan waarbij je snel moet kunnen schakelen, commercieel moet kunnen denken en dient te beschikken over goede communicatieve vaardigheden. Je motiveert, inspireert en bent de rust zelve wanneer druk hoog wordt.

De productieplanner maakt de vertaalslag van orders naar productie en houdt zich bezig met het opstellen, coördineren en bijsturen van de productieplanning. Hij of zij is verantwoordelijk voor de benodigde inzet van personeel, materialen en middelen en heeft affiniteit met drukwerk. De productieplanner moet er voor zorgen dat eindproducten, (half)fabricaten of grondstoffen op het juiste moment op de juiste plaats zijn. Doel van de productieplanner is om het gehele productieproces te organiseren op een zo efficiënt mogelijke wijze om onze snelle levertijden te waarborgen.

Takenpakket

  • Maken en bewaken van productieplanning
  • Bepalen van aantallen mensen, materialen en middelen
  • Aansturen van het productiepersoneel
  • In kaart brengen van benodigde grondstoffen, accessoires en capaciteit
  • Schakelen met de inkoop en verkoop afdeling
  • Ondersteunen van logistieke afdeling
  • Afstemmen met leveranciers en partners

Wat we bieden

De functie betreft minimaal 32 uur per week, minimale ervaring van 2 jaar in een dergelijke functie is gewenst.

Wij bieden jou een leuke en leerzame functie. Het betreft een tijdelijke contract met optie tot een vast dienstverband. Je ontvangt een marktconform salaris.

job.title: EAP项目经理
job.description:
工作职责

  • 开发和拓展EAP的新客户，挖掘客户需求，进行咨询顾问式的销售；
  • 响应企业客户EAP项目的需求，根据客户的需求提供定制化的EAP项目咨询方案；
  • 对已签约的项目进行管理，包括但不限于：项目执行、推进、资源协调、客户反馈等各项工作，为客户交付项目成果；
  • 协助咨询顾问帮助客户有效应对突发危机事件、员工精神疾病等特殊事件。

任职资格

  • 本科及以上学历，拥有心理咨询、社工等教育培训背景优先；
  • 有咨询顾问式销售相关工作经验及项目管理相关经验者优先；
  • 良好的英语读、写能力；
  • 优秀的学习能力、沟通能力和抗压能力；
  • 可熟练使用Word/Excel/PPT等办公软件。

job.title: 大客户销售
job.description:
工作职责

  • 深入理解公司业务战略、商业模式及需求场景，开拓大B端企业客户，完成业务目标；
  • 与B端客户关键人员保持高效沟通并建立良好的合作关系，提升客户满意度，并能基于B端使用场景和延展需求，挖掘二次机会；
  • 负责帮助客户熟悉公司产品，驱动客户对产品的理解和使用，善于聆听，及时沟通并记录反馈，并协调产品经理和技术团队，建立产品优化反馈闭环，提升整体用户体验与竞争力；
  • 完成领导交代的其他任务。

任职资格

  • 专科及以上学历，1年及以上面向大B端客户的经验；
  • 具有IT软件、人力资源或SAAS等B端方面资源优先；具有人力资源专业服务背景、同业公司销售背景优先考虑；
  • 具备优秀的客户沟通能力以及交际技巧，反应敏捷，亲和力强，善于和客户业务部门以及高层对话；
  • 目标导向，勇于开拓进取，有非常强的逻辑思维能力，发现问题解决问题的能力。

job.title: [Global Market] Operation Manager (경력 3년 미만)
job.description:
팀 소개

리워드로 사람의 참여를 만들고, 그 참여에서 새로운 사업의 가능성을 찾습니다. 리워드는 유저에게 새로운 서비스를 경험할 이유를 주고, 광고주에게는 고객을 만날 기회를, 매체에게는 수익과 재방문의 기회를 만듭니다. 버즈빌 Frontier의 Global Market파트는 이 세 가지 가치를 하나의 사업으로 연결합니다. 국내 리워드 광고에서 쌓은 경험을 바탕으로 새로운 광고 상품과 제휴 모델을 만들고, 그 가능성을 해외 시장으로 확장하는 팀입니다.

우리의 미션은 국내에서 만든 리워드 성과를 해외에서도 재현할 수 있는 사업으로 키우고, 그 과정에서 리워드 산업의 새로운 성장 기회를 만드는 것입니다.

직무 소개

  • 리워드 ADN 광고 운영: 네이버 CPA 등 리워드 광고의 캠페인 세팅·QA·라이브를 관리하고, 공급사·상품·매체별 물량, 단가, 예산/캡과 할당 상태를 점검하며 파트너·내부 담당자와 조율합니다.
  • 성과·수익성 개선: 요청·노출·클릭·전환과 광고 수익·매체비·리워드 비용을 확인하고, 지표의 집계 기준과 비용 중복을 대사합니다. 비교 조건을 맞춰 지면 확대·프로모션·운영 변경의 효과를 검증합니다.
  • 파트너 대응·정산 검증: 공급사별 운영 조건과 변경 사항을 관리하고, 전환 인정 건수·단가·기간·통화·반올림 기준을 맞춰 내부/파트너 리포트를 대사합니다. 차액·인보이스·정산 증빙·미수금의 후속 처리를 정산·재무 담당자와 확인합니다.
  • 운영 이슈·제품 개선: 광고 미노출·미션 할당·적립·CS 이슈를 재현 조건과 데이터로 정리하고, PM·개발·CS와 수정·재검증까지 추적합니다. 반복되는 수동 설정과 검증을 체크리스트·운영 기능·AI 활용으로 개선합니다.
  • 국내 성과의 해외 적용: 국내 상품의 성과 조건과 한계를 정리해 해외에 적용할 대상을 찾고, 현지 광고 공급·리워드·지면·유저 행동·정산 조건을 확인하며 연동·QA·출시·프로모션·초기 성과 검증을 진행합니다. 해외 ADN 캠페인의 단가 연동·라이브·운영 이슈도 담당자와 조율합니다.
  • 글로벌 BD·파트너 발굴: 해외 매체·ADN·오퍼월 시장을 조사하고 신규 접촉·미팅·제안을 진행합니다. 고객의 수익화 과제와 도입 조건을 확인해 시험안을 만들고, 실제 결과와 거절·지연 이유를 다음 사업 제안에 반영합니다.

자격요건

  • 스프레드시트로 광고 실적과 정산 수치를 대사하고 기간·단위·집계 기준의 차이를 설명할 수 있는 분
  • 캠페인 설정·파트너 요청·운영 이슈를 꼼꼼하게 관리하고 영향·긴급도에 따라 우선순위를 정할 수 있는 분
  • 사실·가설·확인할 사항을 나눠 문제를 정리하고 PM·개발·CS·정산 담당자와 해결까지 추적할 수 있는 분
  • 시장·고객 정보를 출처와 함께 정리하고, 고객의 필요를 제안·후속 행동으로 연결할 수 있는 분
  • 국내에서 얻은 성과와 실패 원인을 다른 시장에 적용할 때 필요한 조건을 확인하며, AI 결과를 원자료로 검증할 수 있는 분

우대사항

  • 일본어 또는 영어 AL 수준의 회화 역량, 또는 이에 준하는 해외 파트너 실무 커뮤니케이션 경험
  • 리워드 광고·ADN·오퍼월의 캠페인 운영, 광고 물량·성과 관리 또는 매체 수익화 경험
  • 광고 실적·정산 대사, 리워드·매체비 관리, 공급사와의 운영 조건 조율 경험
  • 운영 데이터를 근거로 설정·상품·프로세스를 개선하고 적용 전후를 확인한 경험
  • 해외 매체 제휴·BD·파트너 연동 또는 국내 서비스의 해외 적용 경험
  • SQL·API·포스트백 구조에 대한 이해, AI를 분석·리포트·조사에 활용하고 검증한 경험

이렇게 성장할 수 있어요

  • 글로벌 광고 시장의 돈이 흐르는 구조를 안에서 배울 수 있는 주니어 포지션입니다.
  • 국내 리워드 광고의 실제 물량과 수익을 다루며 운영·분석·파트너 협업 역량을 쌓습니다.
  • 운영에서 찾은 문제를 제품·업무 개선으로 연결하고, 효과를 숫자로 확인합니다.
  • 국내에서 검증한 경험을 해외 제휴와 출시로 확장하며 사업 운영과 BD를 함께 경험합니다.

참고사항

  • 입사 후 프로베이션 3개월 운영이며, 프로베이션 기간 동안의 급여는 100% 지급됩니다.
  • 장애인, 국가유공자, 보훈 대상자는 관련 법령에 따라 우대합니다.
  • 이력서 제출 시 현재 연봉은 기재하지 말아 주세요.

job.title: Head of Marketing & Communication
job.description:
팀 소개

버즈빌의 다음 챕터를 이끌 마케팅 리더를 찾습니다.

버즈빌은 지난 10여 년간 독보적인 리워드 기술로 수많은 프리미엄 매체와 브랜드, 그리고 사용자를 연결하며 애드테크 시장의 혁신을 주도해왔습니다. 이제 우리는 축적된 데이터와 AI 기술을 바탕으로, 브랜드와 사용자가 만나는 방식을 새롭게 설계하는 인터랙션 AI 에이전트 기업으로의 위대한 도약을 앞두고 있습니다.

이 여정의 중심에서, 당신은 버즈빌의 마케팅 조직을 이끌며 비즈니스의 미래를 그리는 역할을 맡게 됩니다. 단순히 마케팅 팀을 관리하는 것을 넘어, 회사의 핵심 리더십 팀과 함께 버즈빌의 다음 성장 단계를 정의하고, AI를 무기로 마케팅이 일하는 방식을 새롭게 만들어갈 분을 찾습니다.

당신이 마주할 도전 (The Opportunity & Challenge)

  • 빠르게 변화하는 AI 시대의 광고 생태계 속에서 버즈빌이 어떤 회사인지 시장에 어떻게 새롭게 각인시킬 것인가?
  • AI를 통해 마케팅이 일하는 방식을 어떻게 더 빠르고 효과적으로 바꿔갈 것인가?
  • 버즈빌의 이야기를 고객과 업계, 언론이 신뢰하는 브랜드로 어떻게 만들어갈 것인가?

당신은 이 질문에 대한 답을 찾아가며, 버즈빌 마케팅과 커뮤니케이션의 모든 전략과 실행을 총괄하는 미션을 수행하게 됩니다.

직무 소개

1. Marketing Vision & Strategy Ownership

  • 회사의 비즈니스 목표와 연계된 중장기 마케팅 비전과 전략을 수립하고 실행을 총괄합니다.
  • 세일즈, 프로덕트 등 유관 부서와의 긴밀한 얼라인을 통해 전사적 성장 전략을 함께 만들어갑니다.
  • 데이터에 기반하여 마케팅 예산을 기획하고, 성과를 극대화하기 위한 리소스 분배를 책임집니다.

2. AI Native Marketing

  • AI를 기반으로 마케팅의 기획부터 실행, 분석까지 일하는 방식을 재설계하고, 팀이 더 빠르고 효과적으로 일할 수 있는 환경을 만듭니다.
  • 새로운 AI 도구와 방식을 먼저 시도하고, 검증된 방식을 팀의 일하는 방식으로 정착시킵니다.

3. Brand & Corporate Communication

  • 회사의 다음 성장 단계에 맞춰 기업 브랜드와 핵심 메시지를 재정립하고, 시장에 버즈빌의 가치를 명확하게 전달합니다.
  • 핵심 미디어와의 관계 구축 및 PR 활동을 통해 버즈빌과 경영진의 목소리를 확산시키고, 이슈 커뮤니케이션 체계를 마련합니다.
  • 고객, 파트너, 업계, 잠재 인재까지 아우르는 일관된 브랜드 경험을 만들어갑니다.

4. High-Performing Team Leadership

  • 빠른 실행 위주의 의사결정 문화를 팀에 내재화하고, 팀원 개개인이 최고의 퍼포먼스를 낼 수 있도록 동기를 부여하고 성장시킵니다.
  • 목표 달성을 위해 팀의 구조와 R&R을 지속적으로 최적화하며 업계 최고의 마케팅 조직을 구축합니다.

자격요건

  • 8년 이상의 B2B 마케팅 또는 그에 준하는 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 애드테크/마테크, AI 또는 B2B SaaS 산업에서 마케팅 전략을 수립하고 팀을 성공적으로 이끌어 본 경험이 있는 분
  • AI를 실무에 직접 활용해 마케팅의 기획, 실행, 분석 방식을 개선하고 이를 구체적인 성과로 만들어 본 분
  • 기업 PR 전략을 수립하고 실행하며, 핵심 미디어와의 관계를 바탕으로 브랜드 인지도와 신뢰도를 높여 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 비즈니스 목표와 연계된 마케팅 전략을 수립하고, 그에 따른 예산을 효과적으로 운영해 본 경험이 있는 분

The Ideal Candidate: Leadership (Culture Book 5.0 핵심가치 기반)

  • 책임에 기반한 자율 (Responsible Autonomy): 지시를 기다리지 않고 마케팅·커뮤니케이션의 과제를 스스로 정의하고, 결과까지 책임지는 리더
  • 불굴 (Grit): 데이터와 사실에 근거해 집요하게 파고들고, 가장 큰 임팩트를 만드는 곳에 집중하는 리더
  • 성장 마인드셋 (Growth Mindset): 익숙한 방식 대신 AI 등 새로운 방식을 먼저 시도하고, 실패에서 배운 점을 팀의 자산으로 만드는 리더
  • 원팀 (One Team): 세일즈·프로덕트·재무·경영진과 원칙 기반으로 협업하며, 회사 전체의 성공을 기준으로 판단하는 리더
  • Player-Coach: 전략가이자 실행가로서 직접 AI로 결과물을 만들며 팀과 함께 뛰는 리더

우대사항

  • 기업 브랜드 리뉴얼(리브랜딩) 또는 브랜드 메시지 체계 재정립을 리딩해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 사업 전환, 대규모 투자 유치 등 회사의 주요 성장 전환기에 기업 커뮤니케이션을 이끌어 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 이슈·위기 커뮤니케이션 체계를 구축하고 실제 상황에 대응해 본 경험이 있는 분
  • 업계 전문가로서 웨비나, 컨퍼런스 등 대외 발표와 경영진 메시지 기획에 자신 있는 분
  • SEO/GEO 등 AI 시대의 검색·콘텐츠 노출 전략에 대한 이해가 있는 분
  • 글로벌 비즈니스 환경에서 비즈니스 레벨 이상의 유창한 영어 구사 능력을 갖추신 분

팀의 AI 활용 방식

Marcom팀은 Claude Code, ChatGPT, 사내 LLM 에이전트를 실무에 사용하고 있으며, 반복되는 분석과 리포트는 이미 자동화되어 있습니다. 메타 광고 성과 리포트, 협력광고 성과 분석, SEO/GEO/PR 모니터링 대시보드 등을 활용하고 있습니다.

Buzzvil에서만 누릴 수 있는 경험

  • 핵심 미션: 리워드 광고 회사에서 인터랙션 AI 에이전트 기업으로 진화하는 버즈빌의 이야기를 직접 설계하고, 고객과 업계, 언론에 일관된 목소리로 전달합니다.

job.title: Sales Manager Benelux I Sales Accelerator Program
job.description:
Imagine having the opportunity to shape the future of retail.

Some follow a proven path, others get to create it. At L, we're launching the International Sales Accelerator Program: a 12-month development program designed to build the next generation of Sales leaders. The program will launch across five European markets, bringing together a group of ambitious peers who will learn, grow and help drive L's next chapter.

This is not a classroom-based training program. From day one, you'll be at the forefront of our growth ambitions, leading client conversations and key commercial opportunities. You'll learn how to identify opportunities through data-driven insights, use AI-powered tools to work smarter, engage with senior decision makers, build compelling commercial strategies and turn conversations into long term partnerships. All while being coached through L's commercial excellence framework, Built to Grow.

What makes this role different?

Over the next 12 months, you'll develop across three core areas:

  • Think like a commercial winner: Learn how top-performing sales professionals create momentum, influence stakeholders, navigate complex negotiations, and build the resilience needed to win in our markets.
  • Master our Total Store Impact proposition: Understand how loyalty, data, retail media, digital activation and customer engagement come together to solve real retailer challenges and create measurable business impact.
  • Build strategic sales expertise: Learn how to manage complex opportunities, navigate buying centers, map stakeholders, develop winning account strategies and use AI-powered sales tools to work smarter and faster.

You'll also spend time working alongside teams across delivery, analytics, operations and customer success, giving you a unique understanding of how our business creates value for clients.

What you'll do

  • Build relationships with senior stakeholders across Europe's leading grocery retailers
  • Create business opportunities in your market, using local knowledge to open doors with leading retailers
  • Develop new commercial opportunities
  • Build data-driven value propositions and business cases, using AI-powered tools and insights to turn client challenges into clear commercial opportunities
  • Support negotiations and help convert opportunities into growth
  • Collaborate with experts across multiple functions to bring the best of L to clients

What you'll bring

We care less about how many years you've spent in sales and more about your ability to spot opportunities, create momentum and continuously raise the bar.

You:

  • Have a commercial instinct
  • Naturally spot opportunities where others see obstacles
  • Enjoy opening doors, creating conversations and influencing decisions
  • Are curious, resilient and energised by the challenge of building something new

You already have experience in sales (retail or FMCG is a plus!), business development, consulting, recruitment or another commercial environment. Most importantly, you're excited about learning, growing and building your career in an international environment, you're willing to travel and you have an excellent command of Dutch and English.

What success looks like

Twelve months from now, you'll have built experience across multiple markets, worked with senior retail leaders, developed advanced commercial skills and become part of the next generation of Sales Founders helping drive L's future growth.

Join the International Sales Accelerator Program and help shape the future of loyalty.

The process

  • Apply by uploading your CV, including a link to a short YouTube video explaining why you are a strong fit for the Sales Accelerator Program and for L (in English!)
  • If there is a potential match, one of our recruiters will contact you by phone
  • Assessment, including a cognitive test, an English test and a personal questionnaire
  • First interview with P&C and the local Sales Director
  • Final interview with the local General Manager and the CHRO
  • Job offer

job.title: Sourcing Manager Print
job.description:
Location: L-house of Loyalty Den Bosch, NL | Hybrid

About the role

We’re looking for a Sourcing Manager Print to take ownership of two key areas within our print business: the sourcing and production of global collectibles and specialised gaming products, and the design and production of in-store displays and POS materials. This includes everything from stickers, collector cards, scratch cards, peel & reveal cards, infinity cards and collector albums to displays, totems, posters, leaflets and stamps. You will ensure these technically complex products are produced to the right quality, security and commercial standards.

You will work closely with specialized print manufacturers, creative teams and logistics partners, combining strong print knowledge with commercial judgement and hands-on problem solving. It’s a role for someone who understands what happens between artwork and finished product, and knows how to keep quality, cost and deadlines under control when volumes are high and timelines are tight.

Key responsibilities

  • Sourcing & supplier management: Source, assess and manage specialized European and global print manufacturers capable of delivering high-volume collectibles and technically complex print products.
  • Print production Cards: Manage the technical production of stickers, collector cards, scratch cards, peel & reveal cards, infinity cards and collector albums, from specification through finished product.
  • Security & compliance monitoring: Safeguard the security requirements of gaming products, including random data distribution, opaque masking, micro security print, hidden unique codes, microtext, Variable Data Printing, guilloche and scramble patterns, ink safeguards and microdots.
  • Print production POS: Manage the technical production of in-store displays and POS materials, including displays, totems, posters, leaflets and stamps, from specification through to finished product.
  • Commercial negotiations: Negotiate volume pricing, contractual terms and SLA’s with manufacturers, balancing commercial value with quality and delivery risk.
  • Quality & color management: Review production files and conduct press checks to ensure color consistency, accurate variable data and reliable adhesion and finishing across print batches.
  • Planning & delivery: Manage critical production timelines together with creative and logistics teams so high-volume, randomized products arrive at retail distribution centers on time and intact.
  • Pricing: Collect accurate information from multiple suppliers and prepare precise quotations and pricing options in the ERP system for NSO’s, often under tight deadlines.
  • Collaboration: Build strong supplier relationships and bring stakeholders together to resolve artwork changes, production issues and last-minute adjustments.

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience as a Print Buyer or Production Manager, ideally within high-volume promotional print, loyalty campaigns or specialized packaging.
  • Proven HBO working and thinking level such as Graphic Media Management.
  • Strong technical knowledge of print processes including flexo, gravure, sheet-fed and digital web printing.
  • Understanding of cold and hot foil applications, secure data varnishing and automated folding techniques.
  • Fluent English for working with international suppliers and vendor networks and fluent Dutch for local market and supplier collaboration.
  • A commercial and analytical approach to negotiation, combined with exceptional attention to detail.
  • A hands-on, proactive working style and the ability to deliver under demanding deadlines with multiple stakeholders.

What we offer

  • A dynamic, international and entrepreneurial environment where bold ideas are valued.
  • A beautiful state-of-the-art office space in Den Bosch within walking distance of the central station.
  • Access to L’s state-of-the-art gym.
  • Flexible working-from-home arrangements up to two days per week.
  • A generous pension plan contribution.

job.title: Projektmitarbeiter der Geschäftsführung (all genders)
job.description:
Direkt an der Spitze mitgestalten.

Als Projektmitarbeiter:in der Geschäftsführung bist Du nah dran an strategischen Entscheidungen, übernimmst Verantwortung in interdisziplinären Projekten und agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle im Unternehmen. Wenn Du Lust auf anspruchsvolle Aufgaben mit direktem Impact hast, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt die Geschäftsführung aktiv bei der strategischen Planung und Koordination vielfältiger, interdisziplinärer Projekte
  • Du führst umfassende Analysen durch und erstellst fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie zielgerichtete Präsentationen für verschiedene Stakeholder
  • Du bist verantwortlich für die Vorbereitung und strukturierte Nachbereitung von strategischen, abteilungsübergreifenden Sitzungen und Workshops
  • Du übernimmst eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion und fungierst als wichtiger Ansprechpartner für alle Bereiche, die eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammenarbeiten

Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fach – idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Marketing oder Touristik
  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position mit
  • Du besitzt ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine hohe Problemlösungskompetenz
  • Du überzeugst mit Teamgeist, Kommunikationsstärke, sozialer Kompetenz und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (insb. Excel & PowerPoint) sowie über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was Dich erwartet

  • Arbeitsumfeld & Organisation: Du arbeitest gerne in unserem Büro am Standort München und schätzt den persönlichen Austausch im Team. Ergänzend kannst du einen Tag pro Woche im Homeoffice arbeiten. Deine Arbeitszeit gestaltest du eigenverantwortlich im Rahmen unserer betrieblichen Anforderungen
  • Workation: Nach Absprache sind bis zu 4 Wochen EU-Workation pro Jahr möglich. Wenn du dich für Fuerteventura entscheidest, unterstützen wir dich zusätzlich mit Flug, Unterkunft und Mietwagen
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung, bringst deine Ideen aktiv ein und arbeitest in einem Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne starre Prozesse
  • Moderner Standort: Freu dich auf einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz in München mit höhenverstellbarem Schreibtisch, viel Grün durch Pflanzen sowie einer offenen Atmosphäre und kurzen Entscheidungswegen
  • Attraktive Benefits: Monatliche Einzahlung auf deine MitarbeiterCARD, Zuschüsse für Mobilfunk & Internet, Bike-Leasing, Auto-Abo, Altersvorsorge & mehr

Über uns

Wir als Belohnungsexperten arbeiten jeden Tag daran, erfolgreiche Innovationen für die Belohnung von Kunden und Mitarbeitern hervorzubringen. Aktuelle internationale Trends sind für uns ebenso wichtig wie unser großes Know-How im Incentive-Bereich. In Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Vertrieb, Service und Produktmanagement hören wir unseren Kunden gut zu, um ihnen die besten zielerfüllenden Lösungen bieten zu können.

Unser Herz schlägt für professionelle Motivationslösungen und jeder bei BONAGO – vom Gründer bis zum Praktikanten – ist mit Leidenschaft dabei. Sei doch auch ein Teil davon!

Bitte beachte: Das Bewerbungsverfahren wird zentral über die ValueNet Group koordiniert. Die ausgeschriebene Stelle gehört zur BONAGO, die Teil der ValueNet Group ist.

job.title: Client Servicing Manager (Loyalty Programs)
job.description:
As a Client Servicing / BD manager for Loyalty Programs, you will be responsible for generating new leads and establishing potential business from various qualified sources to make a positive revenue contribution.

Key Role

  • Primary role of servicing client on loyalty campaigns and employee engagement solutions and over-seeing day-to-day operations of the various projects / campaigns of the client.
  • Understanding client's business and relationship marketing requirements. Meeting up with the clients and taking brief from them.
  • Briefing the client's requirements to the other departments such as Creative, Operations and Technology and overseeing that the work is done in tandem with the client's brief.
  • Data-analysis, reporting and reviewing the Channel loyalty program performance.
  • Handling clients' accounts allocated which involves relationship building with client, communicating details regarding enhancements in program to client in order to increase revenue, enabling smooth operational activities for programs as SPOC between client and internal team.
  • Meeting the SLAs defined within stipulated time frame.
  • Responsible for presenting value proposition of the services and the ideas for the improvisation of program.

Skills

  • Demonstrable customer relationship management
  • Working with the Senior Account Director to strategically coordinate loyalty programs or CRM projects
  • Analytical and confident in briefing work to the internal partners
  • Good presentation skills both in development and delivery
  • Natural attention to detail
  • Strong project management skills
  • Technical skills including technology, CMS systems, data analytics, mobile, digital, social or creative advantageous as is the ability to discuss these areas confidently when dealing with clients and internal departments
  • Advanced software skills including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, MS Project (or equivalent Project management tool)

Preferred Candidate Profile

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in client servicing role with hands on experience in technology, good analytical skills and a strong preference for retail experience.
  • Must have positive attitude and be a team player. Work proficiency with the MS Office suite.
  • Prior experience in growing accounts and mining new opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Exceptional Customer Service and Relationship building experience.
  • Experience in traditional advertising, direct marketing, or similar media environment is a plus.
  • Agency background is highly preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skill.
  • Leadership and organizational abilities.

job.title: Digital Marketing & Technology Specialist
job.description:
All Star Incentives™ · Sturbridge, Massachusetts · Flexible hybrid 3 & 2 work schedule, onsite & remote · Full-time · $80,000-$100,000 base + benefits

The role in one sentence

You will be the person who makes our digital marketing work: the HubSpot portal, the website, the campaigns, the reporting, and the videos that tie it all together.

About us

All Star Incentives™ designs and runs incentive, recognition and rewards programs that help companies change behavior in measurable ways: safety, wellness, sales, service anniversaries and customer loyalty. We have been in the industry for more than 50 years. Our Marketing & Communications team is small, but essential, so your work will be an important part of company success.

What you will do

Roughly how your time will be spent:

  • HubSpot and marketing technology (about 35%). Own our HubSpot portal: workflows, lists, forms, lead routing, intent signals, sales plays, templates and data quality. Work with Sales and IT to keep marketing and sales systems connected, and document how everything is set up.
  • Campaign production (about 25%). Build, code, test and launch emails, newsletters, landing pages, event registrations and surveys for All Star Incentives™ and our clients. QA everything before it goes out.
  • Website and SEO/AEO (about 20%). Keep the website accurate and working. Manage our SEO/AEO agency day to day: set expectations, review deliverables, follow up on gaps, and present quarterly results to the VP Marketing and leadership.
  • Video and multimedia (up to 15%). Edit and produce videos and motion graphics for campaigns, training, events, the website and social media, working from approved concepts and brand standards.
  • Reporting and improvement (about 5%). Turn campaign and web analytics into clear findings and recommendations. Track new tools, AI capabilities and SEO/AEO practices, and recommend the ones worth adopting.

You will report to the VP of Marketing, who sets strategy and priorities. You will work closely with our Senior Graphic Designer & Brand Specialist, who leads visual direction.

What you bring

Required:

  • 6+ years in digital marketing, marketing operations or web production
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience: workflows, lists, forms, email, AI tools, landing pages and reporting
  • HTML and CSS skills for responsive email and landing pages; WordPress experience
  • Working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console and SEO fundamentals
  • Experience managing an outside agency or vendor against deliverables and deadlines
  • Video editing in Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar, plus Photoshop for image work
  • Clear writing and the ability to explain technical results to non-technical people
  • A habit of tracking your own projects, flagging risks early and finishing what you start

Nice to have:

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing Hub, Marketing Software, or Operations)
  • Motion graphics experience
  • Familiarity with AEO (answer engine optimization) and AI tools for marketing
  • Agency experience or B2B marketing experience
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, digital media or a related field, or equivalent experience

How we will measure success

  • HubSpot is reliable, documented and trusted by Sales team
  • Campaigns launch on time and without errors
  • Our SEO/AEO partner delivers what it promised, and leadership gets clear quarterly results
  • The VP of Marketing always knows where projects stand

What we offer

  • Base salary of $80,000-$100,000, based on experience
  • Health and Dental insurance (50% of premium paid by company)
  • Health Savings Account with company contribution
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • A best in class employee recognition & rewards program
  • Professional development and HubSpot certification support

To apply

Send your resume and two or three work samples: a HubSpot workflow or campaign you built, a landing page or email you coded, and a video you edited. Links are fine.

All Star Incentives™ is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status.

job.title: Director of Acquisition Marketing
job.description:
The Director of Acquisition Marketing will head up all of our acquisition marketing initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an ROI-focused, experienced online marketer with in-depth analytics experience to join our growing team. This individual will be responsible for implementing marketing plans that lead to the successful completion of our revenue goals and brand awareness expansion of companies that need Sales and Safety Incentive Programs, Integrated Loyalty Technologies, Consumer Promotion Programs, and Loyalty Marketing Programs.

The ideal candidate will come with demonstrable experience developing and executing advanced-level online marketing plans that generate results, including paid search campaigns, display and retargeting, affiliate marketing, social media campaigns, and partnerships, including client-owned digital channels. This individual will be the subject matter expert regarding digital and offline marketing activities to drive sales and generate traffic to both offline and online channels.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Alignment with Corporate and Brand Marketing.
  • Serve as key support to drive retail store traffic, e-commerce traffic and generate brand buzz.
  • Deliver acquisition marketing plans that optimize for sales and exceed projections.
  • Accountable for management and goal setting of interactive, paid search, natural search, display, email (in partnership with CRM / Email Marketing Team), mobile, and affiliates.
  • Support CRM team to manage and optimize retargeting campaigns to acquire new customers.
  • Source and manage third-party marketing agencies by channel to drive ROI and topline sales.
  • Perform in-depth analysis of channel conversion, selling, and ROI to make recommendations and implement strategies for improvement.
  • Creates, Manages, and Communicates the Online Marketing Strategy, Content and Calendar.
  • Partners with the CRM team to leverage market research and analysis of the competition, customers, market, and industry trends.
  • Assesses new digital marketing partnerships and business development opportunities, provide insightful analysis and recommendations, leads Team to execution.
  • Leverages the use of marketing analytics to provide insights and make recommendations to reach new consumers in new ways and to improve marketing ROI.
  • Ownership of long-term strategy to optimize and lower the customer acquisition costs and increase average sale size.
  • Envision and drive customer acquisition campaigns by building external partnerships with organizations across different verticals.
  • Responsible for digital marketing budget, spend, and related ROI.
  • Tracks and reports on ROI (by channel) daily, weekly, and monthly.
  • Partners with e-commerce product sourcing and corporate marketing to effectively execute campaigns.
  • Actively partners and collaborates with the Brand Marketing Team to ensure the All Digital Rewards concepts and branding effectively translate to the website.
  • Creates a motivating environment that ensures the ongoing training and development of the digital team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 to 7 years’ hands-on experience with e-commerce and digital marketing within the Loyalty Marketing Omni-channel environment.
  • Strong experience in managing and acquiring customers with social media channels.
  • Deep understanding of the digital environment and evolving tools and platforms used to improve online presence with proven results. Able to translate trends into brand right business opportunities to drive to sales goals.
  • Prior experience includes leading and developing a team as well as working with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong expertise in analytics. Preferably in Google Analytics.
  • Strong relationship builder both within the organization and with external partners. Must be able to articulate a vision and develop and deliver supporting marketing plans.
  • Proven experience developing and managing a digital marketing budget and portfolio.
  • Strong leadership, analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Customer-focused with a strong awareness of the online and offline retail environment.
  • Thorough understanding of brand building and buzz generation.
  • Must exhibit a passion for the company’s growth stage and desire to expand and grow awareness for the All Digital Rewards brand and products.
  • Must be willing to travel occasionally for training and alignment with corporate marketing (as required.)

Freedom to Act

Expected to be accountable for own professional action and recognize own professional boundaries, seeking advice where appropriate. Required to work in defined departmental protocols/policies and professional code of conduct. To work independently accessing appraisal within an individual performance framework at pre-determined intervals.

All Digital Rewards offers an empowered work environment that encourages creativity, initiative and professional growth and provides a competitive salary and benefits package. All Digital Rewards is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and maintains a Drug-Free Workplace. We are fully committed to employing a diverse workforce and creating an inclusive work environment that embraces everyone’s unique contributions, experiences, and values. Please apply on our website for consideration.

For consideration for employment, please send your resume to hr@alldigitalrewards.com

job.title: Analista de Produtos SR- Novo Negócios
job.description:
Como será o seu dia a dia?

Nessa jornada conosco, você vai:

  • Liderar operacionalmente o Discovery de iniciativas pré-definidas, em alinhamento com a liderança e autoridade de design dos Especialistas do time e com os stakeholders das áreas envolvidas.
  • Estruturar problemas, perguntas-chave, hipóteses, planos de pesquisa e critérios de decisão; organizar entrevistas, workshops, benchmarks e análises de mercado.
  • Sintetizar necessidades de clientes e usuários, dimensionar oportunidades e traduzir aprendizados em proposta de valor, conceitos de solução e alternativas de modelo de negócio.
  • Suportar na construção de análises econômicas e business cases preliminares, incluindo premissas, cenários, sensibilidades, riscos e indicadores de sucesso.
  • Planejar e acompanhar experimentos, PoCs e MVPs em parceria com especialistas e Product Owner, assegurando rastreabilidade entre hipótese, evidência e recomendação.
  • Produzir narrativas e recomendações executivas; apresentar conclusões, explicitar trade-offs e propor próximos passos nos gates do portfólio.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Curiosidade intelectual, julgamento, autonomia e conforto com ambiguidade.
  • Problem solving estruturado, com rigor analítico e capacidade de síntese executiva.
  • Pesquisa qualitativa e quantitativa, discovery e experimentação.
  • Modelagem financeira e leitura e compreensão de alavancas de negócio.
  • Comunicação clara, facilitação e influência transversal.
  • Gostar de ambientes dinâmicos e ambíguos, de exercitar a flexibilidade, pragmatismo, resiliência.
  • Capacidade comprovada de conduzir entregas multidisciplinares com supervisão por checkpoints, e não por microgestão, com organização para lidar com conteúdos, prazos, metas.
  • Experiência profissional em estratégia, consultoria, inovação, novos negócios, produto ou inteligência de mercado.
  • Graduação completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio de Excel e PowerPoint.

Será um diferencial se você tiver: inglês fluente ou avançado para ouvir apresentações, conteúdo em áudio e vídeo, para pesquisa e produção de materiais para apresentação da empresa para públicos externos. Familiaridade com ferramentas de pesquisa, análise de dados e IA aplicada são diferenciais.

O que nós oferecemos

  • Convênio Médico e Convênio Odontológico.
  • Auxílio Farmácia.
  • Alelo Cultura (adesão opcional).
  • Seguro de Vida.
  • Alelo Alimentação, Alelo Refeição e Alelo Natal.

  • Vale Transporte (adesão opcional), Vale combustível ou fretado.
  • Ajuda de custo para Home Office e para montar seu ambiente de trabalho Home office.
  • Pontuação Livelo e desconto em parceiros.

  • Fique bem Auster: programa de orientação para saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida.

job.description:
Vaga exclusiva para profissionais com deficiência.

Como será o seu dia a dia?

Responsável pela estratégia 360° de marketing das soluções para público RH (B2B), desde o posicionamento e naming de novos produtos, análise de mercado e concorrência, comunicação e demais ações de divulgação.

Apoiar o desenvolvimento da estratégia de marketing para lançamento e manutenção dos produtos/serviços das soluções para público RH (B2B). Garantir e acompanhar a execução do plano definido, identificando oportunidades para potencializar os negócios.

Utilizar ferramentas de comunicação e marketing para desdobramento de ações no dia a dia e aplicação, conforme necessidade do negócio. Desenvolver materiais diversos com foco em fomento de vendas e apoio à implantação em clientes.
